109	    if (va !== ja) { r.dA++; mark(i); if (r.samples.length < 8) r.samples.push(`A(${i % W},${(i / W) | 0}) v${va} j${ja}`); }
110	    const vt = va ? c.t[i]! : 0;
111	    const jt = ja ? (SHEET[st.type[i]!] >= 0 ? SHEET[st.type[i]!]! : 9999) : 0;
112	    if (vt !== jt) {
113	      r.dT++; mark(i);
114	      const k = `T${vt}>${jt}`;
115	      pair.set(k, (pair.get(k) ?? 0) + 1);
116	      if (r.samples.length < 8) r.samples.push(`T(${i % W},${(i / W) | 0}) v${vt} j${jt}`);

119	    if (c.l[i]! !== st.liquid[i]!) { r.dL++; mark(i); if (r.samples.length < 8) r.samples.push(`L(${i % W},${(i / W) | 0}) v${c.l[i]} j${st.liquid[i]}`); }
120	    if (c.hf[i]! !== st.half[i]!) { r.dHf++; mark(i); const k = `H${c.hf[i]}>${st.half[i]}`; pair.set(k, (pair.get(k) ?? 0) + 1); if (r.samples.length < 8) r.samples.push(`H(${i % W},${(i / W) | 0}) v${c.hf[i]} j${st.half[i]}`); }
121	    if (c.sl[i]! !== st.slope[i]!) { r.dSl++; mark(i); const k = `S${c.sl[i]}>${st.slope[i]}`; pair.set(k, (pair.get(k) ?? 0) + 1); if (r.samples.length < 8) r.samples.push(`S(${i % W},${(i / W) | 0}) v${c.sl[i]} j${st.slope[i]}`); }
122	    // lty：仅 liquid>0 的格裁决（vanilla 0 基 ↔ JS +1 基）
123	    const vl = c.l[i]! > 0 ? c.lt[i]! + 1 : 0;
124	    const jl = st.liquid[i]! > 0 ? st.liquidType[i]! : 0;
125	    if (vl !== jl) { r.dLt++; mark(i); const k = `Y${vl}>${jl}`; pair.set(k, (pair.get(k) ?? 0) + 1); if (r.samples.length < 8) r.samples.push(`Y(${i % W},${(i / W) | 0}) v${vl} j${jl} liq${c.l[i]}`); }
126	    const via = c.ia[i]! ? 1 : 0;
127	    const jia = (st.wire[i]! >>> 5) & 1;
128	    if (via !== jia) { r.dIa++; mark(i); if (r.samples.length < 8) r.samples.push(`I(${i % W},${(i / W) | 0}) v${via} j${jia}`); }
129	    // ghost（信息位）：非活性残留 type
130	    const vg = va ? 0 : c.t[i]!;
131	    const jg = ja ? 0 : (SHEET[st.type[i]!] >= 0 ? SHEET[st.type[i]!]! : 9999);
132	    if (vg !== jg) r.dGh++;

134	  if (firstI >= 0) r.first = `(${firstI % W},${Math.floor(firstI / W)})`;
135	  r.pairs = [...pair.entries()].sort((a, b) => b[1] - a[1]).slice(0, 8).map(([k, n]) => [k, n] as [string, number]);
136	  return r;
137	}

151	  else if (rng.int(0, 14) === 0) result = 2292; // 1/15 玻璃钢鱼竿

153	  gs.jungleItemIdx++;

259	const __fr = Math.fround;
260	/** .NET Math.Round(float32 积, MidpointRounding.ToEven) == base（银行家舍入） */
261	function netRoundEq(base: number, mult: number): boolean {
262	  const v = __fr(__fr(base) * __fr(mult));   // (float)base * mult 在 float32 域
263	  const fl = Math.floor(v);
264	  const diff = v - fl;
265	  let r: number;
266	  if (diff > 0.5) r = fl + 1;
267	  else if (diff < 0.5) r = fl;
268	  else r = fl % 2 === 0 ? fl : fl + 1;       // 恰 .5 → 取偶
269	  return r === base;
270	}
271	/** Item.Prefix while 环四失败门（cs:546-550 → flag=true 重进环） */
272	function prefixTryGetFails(rolled: number, item: number): boolean {
273	  const s = PRE_STATS[item];
274	  if (!s) return false;                      // 配饰池（62-80）无乘子 → 恒通过
275	  const m = PRE_MULT[rolled];
276	  if (!m) return false;                      // 前缀无四项乘子 → 恒通过
277	  if (m[0] !== 1 && netRoundEq(s.d, m[0])) return true;
278	  if (m[2] !== 1 && netRoundEq(s.ua, m[2])) return true;
279	  if (m[3] !== 1 && netRoundEq(s.mana, m[3])) return true;
280	  if (m[1] !== 1 && s.kb0) return true;
281	  return false;
282	}
283	/** Prefix(-1) 耗掷（结果不入箱——原版前缀只改数值；此函数只保流）。
284	 *  1:1 while 环（cs:523-556）：Next(4)==0 早退 → 池 Next(len) → Reduced Next(3)
285	 *  → TryGet 四失败门失败则重进环（Next(4)+池再掷——GG 批残余①：地狱尾 3-4 掷） */
286	function prefixRolls(rng: RNG, item: number): void {
287	  const cls = PRE_CLASS[item];
288	  if (!cls) return;                       // 调用点但不可前缀化（50/997/930/5010…）或原版未调
289	  const arr = PRE_POOLS[cls]!;
290	  let rolled = -1;
291	  for (let flag = true; flag; ) {
292	    flag = false;
293	    if (rolled === -1 && rng.int(0, 3) === 0) rolled = 0;          // cs:526 Next(4)
294	    if (rolled === -1) rolled = arr[rng.int(0, arr.length - 1)]!;  // cs:534 RollAPrefix
295	    if (PRE_REDUCED.has(rolled) && rng.int(0, 2) !== 0) rolled = 0; // cs:538 Next(3)
296	    if (prefixTryGetFails(rolled, item)) { flag = true; rolled = -1; } // cs:546 失败重掷
297	  }
298	}

302	/**
303	 * AddBuriedChest 战利品主体(cs:36283-37360)1:1:按深度四分支。
304	 * mainVanillaId>0 → 主题主件(冰箱/沙箱/常春藤/水箱/地狱/金字塔等),
305	 * 否则按分支掷默认主件;各分支再按原版顺序逐项掷概率杂物表。
306	 */
307	export function rollChestLoot(ctx: LootCtx, mainVanillaId: number): Array<{ id: number; stack: number } | null> {
308	  const { rng, gs, gy, flags } = ctx;
309	  const bars = barIds(gs);
310	  const out: Array<{ id: number; stack: number }> = [];
311	  const push = (v: number, stack = 1) => {
312	    const id = vid(v);
313	    if (id >= 0 && out.length < 40) out.push({ id, stack });
314	  };
315	  const pick = (arr: number[]) => arr[rng.int(0, arr.length - 1)];
316	
317	  // ---- 分支判定(cs:36283 flag23 / 36563 / 36789 / 37163)----
318	  // 地表分支 = 木箱(style0 flag)/天空箱(style12 flag6)且深度(ws+25) 之外，
319	  // ★flag11（cs:36221：tile21+style≠0+主件∈{848,857,934}）= 金字塔主件箱
320	  //   **无视深度恒走地表/金字塔分支**——曾只按深度判（深层金字塔箱误入金箱分支，
321	  //   掷骰序列整体偏移，金字塔出口隧道相位漂移，dump 对拍实锤）
322	  const isPyrMain = mainVanillaId === 848 || mainVanillaId === 857 || mainVanillaId === 934;
323	  const isSurface = isPyrMain || (gy < gs.worldSurface + 25 && !!(flags.wooden || flags.sky));
324	  // ★cs:36839 第二档门 = num7 < maxTilesY-250（地狱档为 else）——曾用 rockLevel
325	  //   判金档：蜘蛛巢深带 y∈[h-250,h-205) 误走地狱档（#63 波前分叉根因之一）
326	  // ★四档链（IL 实证 +0x1419/+0x1DFB：反编译把第二档门折进 flag23 remix 段致漏读）：
327	  //   地表(flag23&&wooden/sky) → 金档(y<rockLayer,非 remix) → 洞穴档(y<h-250,
328	  //   cs:36839) → 地狱档。UUUU 批经 /tmp/uuuu-app 织入探针逐掷对拍定谳。
329	  const isGold = gy < gs.rockLevel;
330	
331	  if (isSurface) {
332	    // ===== 地表木箱/天空箱(cs:36283-36468)=====
333	    if (mainVanillaId > 0) {
334	      push(mainVanillaId);
335	      prefixRolls(rng, mainVanillaId);   // cs:36287 SetDefaults+Prefix(-1)
336	      if (mainVanillaId === 832) push(933); // cs:36287-36291 世界树主件后插叶法杖
337	      if (mainVanillaId === 848) push(866); // cs:36283-36286 金字塔主件附赠法老袍
338	      if (flags.sky) {
339	        if (rng.int(0, 2) === 0) push(5629);
340	        if (rng.int(0, 5) === 0) push(rng.int(0, 1) === 0 ? 4429 : 4427);
341	        if (rng.int(0, 2) !== 0) push(5528);
342	      }
343	    } else {
344	      const m = pick([280, 281, 284, 285, 953, 946, 3068, 3069, 3084, 4341]);
345	      push(m);
346	      prefixRolls(rng, m);   // cs:36322-36415：十选一 SetDefaults+Prefix(-1)
347	    }
348	    if (rng.int(0, 5) === 0) push(282, rng.int(40, 75));   // 1/6 荧光棒
349	    if (rng.int(0, 5) === 0) push(279, rng.int(150, 300)); // 1/6 飞刀
350	    if (rng.int(0, 5) === 0) {                             // 1/6 草药袋(附赠叠层)
351	      let n = 1;
352	      if (rng.int(0, 4) === 0) n += rng.int(0, 1);
353	      if (rng.int(0, 9) === 0) n += rng.int(0, 2);
354	      push(3093, n);
355	    }
356	    if (rng.int(0, 5) === 0) {                             // 1/6 虫罐
357	      let n = 1;
358	      if (rng.int(0, 4) === 0) n += rng.int(0, 1);
359	      if (rng.int(0, 9) === 0) n += rng.int(0, 2);
360	      push(4345, n);
361	    }
362	    if (rng.int(0, 2) === 0) push(168, rng.int(3, 5));     // 1/3 手雷
363	    if (rng.int(0, 1) === 0) push(rng.int(0, 1) === 0 ? bars.copper : bars.iron, rng.nextInt(8) + 3);   // cs:36439 Next(8)+3
364	    if (rng.int(0, 1) === 0) push(965, rng.int(50, 100));  // 绳
365	    if (rng.int(0, 2) !== 0) push(rng.int(0, 1) === 0 ? 40 : 42, rng.nextInt(26) + 25); // 木箭/手里剑 cs:36461 Next(26)+25
366	    if (rng.int(0, 1) === 0) push(28, rng.nextInt(3) + 3);      // 弱效治疗药水 cs:36475 Next(3)+3
367	    if (rng.int(0, 2) !== 0) push(2350, rng.int(3, 5));    // 回城药水
368	    if (rng.int(0, 2) > 0) push(pick([292, 298, 299, 290, 2322, 2325]), rng.int(1, 2));
369	    if (rng.int(0, 1) === 0) push(rng.int(0, 1) === 0 ? 8 : 31, rng.nextInt(11) + 10);  // 火把/瓶子 cs:36520 Next(11)+10

371	    if (rng.int(0, 1) === 0) push(9, rng.int(50, 99));     // 木材
372	  } else if (isGold) {

591	/** AddBuriedChest（1456 cs:35920）下落/门禁段 1:1：

594	 *  ±2 邻域（InWorld 100 边距）有 Boulders{138,484,664,665,711-716}/祭坛 26/蜥蜴祭坛 237 → 失败
595	 *  ——该检查在扫描循环内**逐行**执行（锚=当前行 k，cs:35992-36002），非仅起始行。
596	 *  notNearOtherChests:true 时经 Chest.NearOtherChests（±25×±8 已有箱）拒绝（cs:36253 透传）。
597	 *  样式/战利品解析与 2×2 放置沿用本仓库 rollChestLoot 管线。 */
598	export function placeBuriedChest(
599	  st: TileStore, rng: RNG, gs: GenState, chests: ChestSink,
600	  i: number, j: number, opts: { style?: number; tile?: number; loot?: number | string; flags?: ChestFlags; trySlope?: boolean; notNearOtherChests?: boolean } = {},
601	): boolean {
602	  // 探针（AB/ABX 对拍 vanilla ChestProbe；无钩零开销）
603	  const __ab = (globalThis as { __swChestEv?: (p: string, i: number, j: number, x?: number) => void }).__swChestEv;
604	  const __n0 = (globalThis as { __swRollN?: number }).__swRollN ?? -1;
605	  __ab?.('ab', i, j, __n0);
606	  try {
607	    const r = placeBuriedChestInner(st, rng, gs, chests, i, j, opts);
608	    __ab?.('abx', i, j, r ? 1 : 0);
609	    return r;
610	  } catch (e) {
611	    __ab?.('abx', i, j, -1);
612	    throw e;
613	  }
614	}

616	function placeBuriedChestInner(
617	  st: TileStore, rng: RNG, gs: GenState, chests: ChestSink,
618	  i: number, j: number, opts: { style?: number; tile?: number; loot?: number | string; flags?: ChestFlags; trySlope?: boolean; notNearOtherChests?: boolean } = {},
619	): boolean {
620	  // 下落到地面（cs:35931 `for k=j; k<maxTilesY-10; k++`）
621	  // ★DDDD:坠落谓词 = WorldGen.SolidTile(i,k)（cs:70155:active && tileSolid && !tileSolidTop
622	  //   && !half && slope==0 && !inActive）——平台/桌族(solidTop)不拦截坠落,vanilla house17
623	  //   宝箱(1863,541)穿过楼梯平台落 548(x86 CPB 实锤);曾用 solidTileHB(!d.platform)——
624	  //   桌族(87 等无 d.platform 旗)误当拦截层。六谓词与 PC_SOLID_TOP 表一致。
625	  const solidDrop = (lx: number, ly: number): boolean => {
626	    if (!st.inBounds(lx, ly)) return false;
627	    const i = st.idx(lx, ly);
628	    if (!st.flags[i]) return false;
629	    const t = st.type[i];
630	    return genSolidType(t) && !PC_SOLID_TOP.has(TILE_DEFS[t]?.vanilla?.sheet ?? -1)
631	      && st.half[i] === 0 && st.slope[i] === 0;
632	  };
633	  let gy = j;
634	  let slopeL = -1, slopeR = -1;   // trySlope 压平的坡度（失败时回填，cs:37567-37575）
635	  for (; gy < st.h - 10; gy++) {
636	    const k = st.idx(i, gy);
637	    if (st.liquid[k] > 0 && st.liquidType[k] === 4) return false;              // anyShimmer → 整体失败
638	    if (st.flags[k] && st.type[k] === LARVA) return false;                      // 幼虫 231 → 整体失败
639	    // ★±2 巨石/祭坛拒绝在扫描循环内**逐行**执行（cs:35992-36002，锚=当前行 k：
640	    //   InWorld(n,num6,100) && Boulders{138,484,664,665,711-716} || 26 || 237）。
641	    //   曾在进循环前以起始行 j 只查一次——起始行下方 2 格内的滚石/祭坛全部漏检
642	    for (let dx = -2; dx <= 2; dx++) {
643	      for (let dy = -2; dy <= 2; dy++) {
644	        const xx = i + dx, yy = gy + dy;
645	        if (xx < 100 || yy < 100 || xx >= st.w - 100 || yy >= st.h - 100) continue;
646	        const kk = st.idx(xx, yy);
647	        if (!st.flags[kk]) continue;
648	        const tt = st.type[kk];
649	        if (BOULDER_TILES.has(tt) || tt === ALTAR || tt === TALTAR) return false;
650	      }
651	    }
652	    if (solidDrop(i, gy)) {
653	      // trySlope 门（cs:35951-35968）：style 17 时 ±30 盒内不得有箱/越界；
654	      // 压平 (i-1,gy)/(i,gy) 的顶坡供放置（失败时回填）
655	      if (opts.trySlope && opts.style === 17) {
656	        for (let l = i - 30; l <= i + 30; l++) {
657	          for (let m = gy - 30; m <= gy + 30; m++) {
658	            if (l < 5 || m < 5 || l >= st.w - 5 || m >= st.h - 5) return false;  // InWorld(l,m,5)
659	            const nk = st.idx(l, m);
660	            if (st.flags[nk] && (st.type[nk] === CHEST || st.type[nk] === CHEST2)) return false;
661	          }
662	        }
663	      }
664	      if (opts.trySlope) {
665	        if (st.slope[st.idx(i - 1, gy)] >= 1 && st.slope[st.idx(i - 1, gy)] <= 2) {
666	          slopeL = st.slope[st.idx(i - 1, gy)];
667	          st.slope[st.idx(i - 1, gy)] = 0;
668	        }
669	        if (st.slope[k] >= 1 && st.slope[k] <= 2) {
670	          slopeR = st.slope[k];
671	          st.slope[k] = 0;
672	        }
673	      }
674	      break;
675	    }
676	  }
677	  if (gy >= st.h - 10) return false;
678	  if (!solidDrop(i, gy)) return false;
679	  // trySlope 失败回填（cs:37567-37575：仅压平过的格才恢复）

854	/** Buried Chests pass:L7907 洞穴段(CaveChestCount 35-40 × WorldArea/5040000)。
855	 *  ★地狱段拆出 runUnderworldChestsPass:本函数曾在 hellPass 之前执行,
856	 *  地狱箱被后续地狱地形重写 100% 抹除(实际 0 个) */
857	export function runBuriedChestsPass(st: TileStore, rng: RNG, gs: GenState, chests: ChestSink): void {
858	  const { w, h } = st;
859	  const yMin = Math.floor((gs.worldSurfaceHigh + 20 + gs.rockLevel) / 2);
860	  // 洞穴箱:35-40 × 面积缩放(Configuration.json CaveChestCount ScaleWith:WorldArea)。
861	  // ★WorldGenRange.GetRandom(WorldGenRange.cs:34-57):先缩放边界再 (int) 截断 →
862	  //   Next((int)(35s), (int)(40s)+1)。曾"先掷后乘+Math.round"(C10 同款旧公式)
863	  const target = gs.caveChestCount >= 0 ? gs.caveChestCount
864	    : rng.int(Math.trunc(35 * (w * h) / 5040000), Math.trunc(40 * (w * h) / 5040000));
865	  let fail = 10000;
866	  // cs:17112-17124 拒绝门：wallDungeon[wall] || wall==87 || oceanDepths(x,y)
867	  //   （oceanDepths = y ≤ oceanLevel(=(ws+rl)/2+40) 且 x<380 || x>w-380——尾批 2-C 补；
868	  //   曾漏致海带尝试多掷 1 次 AB，流分叉 @AB#69 (3826,490) 实证）
869	  const oceanLevel = (gs.worldSurface + gs.rockLevel) / 2 + 40;
870	  for (let n = 0; n < target && fail > 0; ) {
871	    const x = rng.int(20, w - 21);
872	    const y = rng.int(yMin, h - 231);
873	    const wl = st.inBounds(x, y) ? st.wall[st.idx(x, y)] : -1;
874	    // cs:17109：wallDungeon[wall] || wall == 87（神庙墙 87 独立门）→ 整体重掷
875	    if (isDungeonWall(wl) || wl === 87 || (y <= oceanLevel && (x < gs.beachDistance || x > w - gs.beachDistance))
876	      || !placeBuriedChest(st, rng, gs, chests, x, y)) {
877	      fail--; continue;
878	    }
879	    n++;
880	  }
881	}

889	  const target = gs.underworldChestCount >= 0 ? gs.underworldChestCount
890	    : rng.int(Math.trunc(10 * (w / 4200)), Math.trunc(15 * (w / 4200)));
891	  let fail = 10000;

895	    // cs:17134-17140：wallDungeon[wall] → 整体重掷（无 wall==87/oceanDepths 门）
896	    const wl = st.inBounds(x, y) ? st.wall[st.idx(x, y)] : -1;
897	    if (isDungeonWall(wl) || !placeBuriedChest(st, rng, gs, chests, x, y)) {

900	    n++;

904	/** Surface Chests pass(L8019):w*0.005 个地表木箱(style 0;墙 244 → 天空箱 style 12) */
905	export function runSurfaceChestsPass(st: TileStore, rng: RNG, gs: GenState, chests: ChestSink): void {
906	  const { w } = st;
907	  const count = Math.floor(w * 0.005);
908	  for (let n = 0; n < count; n++) {
909	    let ok = false;
910	    for (let tries = 0; tries < 2000 && !ok; tries++) {
911	      // cs:17244 首掷 Next(200, w-200);仅落点命中 oceanDepths(cs:17246-17254:
912	      // y ≤ oceanLevel=(ws+rl)/2+40 且 x 在海滩带内)才改掷 Next(300, w-300)——
913	      // 原版 WorldGen.beachDistance 是常量 380(cs:4102)
914	      let x = rng.int(200, w - 201);
915	      let y = rng.int(Math.floor(gs.worldSurfaceLow), Math.floor(gs.worldSurface) - 1);
916	      const oceanLevel = (gs.worldSurface + gs.rockLevel) / 2 + 40;
917	      while (y <= oceanLevel && (x < gs.beachDistance || x > w - gs.beachDistance)) {
918	        x = rng.int(300, w - 301);
919	        y = rng.int(Math.floor(gs.worldSurfaceLow), Math.floor(gs.worldSurface) - 1);
920	      }
921	      if (!st.inBounds(x, y)) continue;
922	      const i = st.idx(x, y);
923	      // cs:17260-17284 两分支：空格走墙门（2/59/244，墙 244 → 天空箱）；
924	      // 落点活性格走 101×101（步 2）蓄水池采样找墙 244 空格（Next(num8) 命中即换点）
925	      let sky = false;
926	      let cx = x, cy = y;
927	      if (!st.flags[i]) {
928	        if (st.wall[i] === 2 || st.wall[i] === 59 || st.wall[i] === 244) {
929	          if (st.wall[i] === 244) sky = true;
930	        } else {
931	          continue;   // flag3=false → 本轮作废
932	        }
933	      } else {
934	        // ★GG 批尾案②根因：原版扫描界用**固定锚** num6/num7（cs:17274 = 初掷 x/y），
935	        //   命中点写进独立的 num3/num4——曾直接用 cx/cy 兼任界与选中点，命中后界随
936	        //   选中点漂移（越扫越远+候选序错乱：初掷 (409,252) 选中 (547,328) 越出
937	        //   [359,459] 框，AB#2 k=314 vs vanilla k=175 实锤 → 位置半数差+8.2k 欠掷）
938	        let num8 = 1;
939	        let hit = false;
940	        for (let j = x - 50; j <= x + 50; j += 2) {
941	          for (let k = y - 50; k <= y + 50; k += 2) {
942	            if (k >= gs.worldSurface) continue;
943	            if (!st.inBounds(j, k) || st.flags[st.idx(j, k)]) continue;
944	            if (st.wall[st.idx(j, k)] !== 244) continue;
945	            if (rng.int(0, num8 - 1) !== 0) continue;                    // Next(num8)==0
946	            sky = true;
947	            num8++;
948	            hit = true;
949	            cx = j; cy = k;
950	          }
951	        }
952	        if (!hit) continue;   // 蓄水池无墙 244 空格 → 本轮作废
953	      }
954	      const flags: ChestFlags = sky ? { sky: true } : { wooden: true };
955	      // cs:17282：notNearOtherChests:true（NearOtherChests 拒绝 → 重试多掷——#60 欠掷
956	      //   15.9k 主因之一，2026-08-17 尾批 2-C 补传）；style 原版传 flag2?12:-1，
957	      //   -1 走落点解析（地表恒 y<worldSurface → style 0）与显式 0 等价
958	      if (placeBuriedChest(st, rng, gs, chests, cx, cy, { style: sky ? 12 : 0, flags, notNearOtherChests: true })) ok = true;
959	    }
960	  }
961	}

963	/** UnderwaterChests 的 9×w/4200 段（cs:17381-17453）：每下标两趟 while 各 1 箱——
964	 *  ① y∈[1, UnderworldLayer)（内层液体重掷域 [50, UnderworldLayer)）
965	 *  ② y∈[worldSurface, UnderworldLayer)。主件序：单次 Next(10)==0 → 863，
966	 *  否则计数器 186→4404→277→187（num4 每迭代无条件 ++，命中 863 也前进）。 */
967	export function runWaterChestsPass(st: TileStore, rng: RNG, gs: GenState, chests: ChestSink): void {

976	      main = 863;

980	        case 2: main = 4404; break;

280	      if (!supportOk(st, k, obj.y0 + obj.h)) { dead = true; break; }
281	    }
282	  }
283	  if (!dead) return;
284	  // ★DDDD KillTile 尘粒耗掷（x86 三级探针 TF/MD/KillTile 织入实测）：
285	  //   每击杀格 = KillTile_GetTileDustAmount(fail=false)=10 次 MakeTileDust（cs:66661
286	  //   默认 10）→ KillTile 尾 SquareTileFrame。吊灯(34) 每 MD +1 掷（house17-room1
287	  //   ③ 清 (1859,541)→邻帧 CheckChand 击杀 room2 吊灯 9 格×10 掷=90 掷 = #59 首分歧
288	  //   主根因）；小堆(185)/骨堆(186)/桌族(14/87/88/469)/琴(87) 击杀 0 掷（house0
289	  //   (752..753,878) 双格杀 20 MD 同 k 0 掷 + 多组 6 格杀 60 MD 0 掷实锤）。
290	  //   ★反编译 MakeTileDust 的 num 表控制流不可信（34 标 -1 实测掷、185/186 标 ≥0
291	  //   实测零掷）——全按 x86 实测：仅 34 耗掷。
292	  const anchorI = st.inBounds(obj.x0, obj.y0) ? st.idx(obj.x0, obj.y0) : -1;
293	  const killSheet = anchorI >= 0 ? (TILE_DEFS[st.type[anchorI]!]?.vanilla?.sheet ?? -1) : -1;
294	  if (killSheet === 34) {                       // 吊灯族：每击杀格 10 掷
295	    for (let c = 0; c < obj.w * obj.h * 10; c++) rng.int(0, 2);
296	  }
297	  for (let dx = 0; dx < obj.w; dx++) {
298	    for (let dy = 0; dy < obj.h; dy++) {
299	      const ci = st.idx(obj.x0 + dx, obj.y0 + dy);
300	      houseObjCells.delete(ci);
301	      st.setTileSilent(obj.x0 + dx, obj.y0 + dy, 0);
302	    }
303	  }
304	}

306	/** WorldGen.PlaceTile 派发到各型放置器（FillRooms/cascadePlace 用到的型别全收） */
307	function placeFurniture(st: TileStore, key: string, x: number, y: number, style = 0, _anchor?: string): boolean {
308	  const t = TILE_BY_KEY[key];
309	  if (t === undefined) return false;
310	  const sheet = TILE_DEFS[t]?.vanilla?.sheet ?? -1;
311	  switch (sheet) {
312	    case 240: case 440: {           // Place3x3Wall(cs:44281)：(x-1,y-1) 3×3，style>35 行卷绕
313	      let s = style, row = 0;
314	      while (s > 35) { row++; s -= 36; }
315	      return placeWallArt(st, x - 1, y - 1, 3, 3, t, (dx) => s * 54 + dx * 18, (dy) => row * 54 + dy * 18);
316	    }
317	    case 245:                       // Place2x3Wall(cs:44595)：(x,y-1) 2×3
318	      return placeWallArt(st, x, y - 1, 2, 3, t, (dx) => style * 36 + dx * 18, (dy) => dy * 18);
319	    case 246:                       // Place3x2Wall(cs:44752)：(x-1,y) 3×2
320	      return placeWallArt(st, x - 1, y, 3, 2, t, (dx) => dx * 18, (dy) => style * 36 + dy * 18);
321	    case 241:                       // Place4x3Wall(cs:44874)：(x-1,y-1) 4×3
322	      return placeWallArt(st, x - 1, y - 1, 4, 3, t, (dx) => style * 54 + dx * 18, (dy) => dy * 18);
323	    case 242:                       // Place6x4Wall(cs:44959)：(x-2,y-2) 6×4
324	      return placeWallArt(st, x - 2, y - 2, 6, 4, t, (dx) => (style % 27) * 72 + dx * 18, (dy) => Math.floor(style / 27) * 108 + dy * 18);
325	    case 34: {                      // PlaceChand(cs:52753)：(x-1,y) 3×3 吊挂；门=九格 !active
326	      //   + (x,y-1) nactive && tileSolid && !tileSolidTop——【无下方承地门】(吊灯
327	      //   悬顶),曾误走 placeFloorObject 的 below 检查 → 房内吊灯全灭(room1 实锤)
328	      if (!st.inBounds(x, y - 1) || !solid2(st, x, y - 1) || HOUSE_SOLID_TOP.has(sheetOf(st, x, y - 1))) return false;
329	      for (let dx = -1; dx <= 1; dx++) {
330	        for (let dy = 0; dy < 3; dy++) {
331	          if (!st.inBounds(x + dx, y + dy) || st.flags[st.idx(x + dx, y + dy)] !== 0) return false;
332	        }
333	      }
334	      for (let dx = -1; dx <= 1; dx++) {
335	        for (let dy = 0; dy < 3; dy++) {
336	          st.setTileSilent(x + dx, y + dy, t, Math.floor(style / 36) * 108 + (dx + 1) * 18, style * 54 + dy * 18);
337	        }
338	      }
339	      regHouseObj(st, x - 1, y, 3, 3, 'chand');
340	      return true;
341	    }
342	    case 14: case 26: case 86: case 87: case 88: case 89: case 114: case 187: case 215: case 217: case 218:
343	    case 377: case 469:             // Place3x2(cs:52097)：(x-1,y-1) 3×2，下方逐列 SolidTile2
344	      return placeFloorObject(st, x - 1, y - 1, 3, 2, t, (dx) => style * 54 + dx * 18, (dy) => dy * 18);
345	    case 186:                       // Place3x2 + InvalidTileForPilesOrSpeleothems（拒 Boulders 垫）
346	      return placeFloorObject(st, x - 1, y - 1, 3, 2, t, (dx) => style * 54 + dx * 18, (dy) => dy * 18, true);
347	    case 16: case 18: case 29: case 103: case 134: case 462:   // Place2x1(cs:47371)：(x,y) 2×1
348	      return placeFloorObject(st, x, y, 2, 1, t, (dx) => style * 36 + dx * 18, () => 0);
349	    case 94: case 95: case 97: case 98: case 99: case 100: case 125: case 126: case 172: case 173:
350	    case 287: case 751: case 752:   // Place2x2(cs:51352)：(x-1,y-1) 2×2（94 keg 在此）
351	      return placeFloorObject(st, x - 1, y - 1, 2, 2, t, (dx) => style * 36 + dx * 18, (dy) => dy * 18);
352	    case 101:                       // Place3x4(cs:51943)：(x-1,y-3) 3×4 + SquareTileFrame（零掷）
353	      return placeFloorObject(st, x - 1, y - 3, 3, 4, t, (dx) => style * 54 + dx * 18, (dy) => dy * 18);
354	    case 219:                       // case106 族 Place3x3(cs:53549 num=-2 段)：(x-1,y-2) 3×3
355	      return placeFloorObject(st, x - 1, y - 2, 3, 3, t, (dx) => style * 54 + dx * 18, (dy) => dy * 18);
356	    case 506:                       // Place2xX(case 104 族)：(x,y-2) 2×3
357	      return placeFloorObject(st, x, y - 2, 2, 3, t, (dx) => style * 36 + dx * 18, (dy) => dy * 18);
358	    default:
359	      return false;                 // 未收录型别保守拒绝（勿静默错位）
360	  }
361	}

363	/** 雕像(2×3,style*36 步长);STATUES_WITH_TRAPS 命中 → 邻近飞镖陷阱+接线。
364	 *  ★HouseBuilder.cs:483-491：FillRooms 的陷阱调用【无条件】——PlaceTile(105)
365	 *  失败（目标格被占/腿不实）也照调 PlaceStatueTrap（陷阱+红线可独立落位）。
366	 *  曾把 placeStatueTrap 关进放置成功分支 → 4 座小屋漏陷阱+45 格漏线 → 下游
367	 *  ±25 红线扫描翻转 #59 全部 193 格残差（9293480 (3201,366) golden 实锤：
368	 *  雕像 (3200,364) 被 62 挡、vanilla 仍落陷阱 (3192,366)+线 3192..3201）。
369	 *  注意与 Statues pass 相区分：那边 cs:17045 是 `tile.active()&&type==x`
370	 *  成功门内才调（JS StatuesPass 同构，勿互搬）。
371	 *  GGGGG：placeStatueTrap 共享版带 PlaceTile(135) 尾 SquareTileFrame 内联级联
372	 *  （与 vanilla HouseBuilder→PlaceStatueTrap→PlaceTile 同构；WWWW kstage 快照
373	 *  扫描对零掷击杀幂等，掷型检查(184/165 重帧)以内联为准=vanilla 流位）。 */
374	function placeStatue(st: TileStore, rng: RNG, x: number, y: number, idx: number): boolean {
375	  const [sheet, style] = STATUE_LIST[idx];
376	  const tile = sheet === 349 ? STATUE_349 : STATUE_105;
377	  let ok = true;
378	  if (!tile || !st.inBounds(x + 1, y - 2)) ok = false;
379	  else if (!solid2(st, x, y + 1) || !solid2(st, x + 1, y + 1)) ok = false;
380	  else {
381	    for (let dx = 0; dx < 2 && ok; dx++) {
382	      for (let dy = -2; dy <= 0; dy++) {
383	        if (st.flags[st.idx(x + dx, y + dy)]) { ok = false; break; }
384	      }
385	    }
386	    if (ok) {
387	      // 雕像帧换行（Place2xX case 105，cs:39716-39720）：每行 55 列——
388	      // frameX=(style%55)*36、frameY=floor(style/55)*54（与 StatuesPass 同实现；
389	      // 此前单轴 style*36，style≥55 越界错位）
390	      const row = Math.floor(style / 55);
391	      for (let dx = 0; dx < 2; dx++) {
392	        for (let dy = 0; dy < 3; dy++) {
393	          st.setTileSilent(x + dx, y - 2 + dy, tile, (style - row * 55) * 36 + dx * 18, row * 54 + dy * 18);
394	        }
395	      }
396	      regHouseObj(st, x, y - 2, 2, 3, 'floor');
397	    }
398	  }
399	  if (STATUES_WITH_TRAPS.has(idx)) placeStatueTrap(st, rng, x, y);
400	  return ok;
401	}

403	// ---------- 画(RandHousePicture cs:35336 / Desert cs:35286) ----------
404	const PIC_240 = [26, 28, 20, 21, 22, 24, 25, 33, 34, 35, 76, 77, 78, 79, 82, 96, 98, 100];
405	const PIC_245 = [0, 3, 5, 6, 14, -1, 19, 20, 21]; // -1 → 15+rng(4)
406	const PIC_246 = [1, 30, 31, 32, 33, 34, 35, 36];
407	function randHousePicture(rng: RNG): [string, number] {
408	  let n = rng.int(0, 3);
409	  if (n >= 3 && rng.int(0, 1) !== 0) n = rng.int(0, 2);
410	  if (n <= 1) return ['v_240_wall_hangings_3x3', PIC_240[rng.int(0, 17)]];
411	  if (n === 2) {
412	    let s = rng.int(0, 8);
413	    if (s === 0 && rng.int(0, 2) !== 0) s = rng.int(0, 8);
414	    const style = s === 5 ? 15 + rng.int(0, 3) : PIC_245[s];
415	    return ['v_245_paintings_2x3', style];
416	  }
417	  return ['v_246_paintings_3x2', PIC_246[rng.int(0, 7)]];
418	}
419	function randHousePictureDesert(rng: RNG): [string, number] {
420	  const n = rng.int(0, 3);
421	  if (n <= 1) return ['v_240_wall_hangings_3x3', [63, 64, 65, 66, 67, 68][rng.int(0, 5)]];
422	  if (n === 2) return ['v_245_paintings_2x3', 7 + rng.int(0, 1)];
423	  return ['v_242_paintings_6x4', 37 + rng.int(0, 5)];
424	}

426	// ---------- 原版 GenAction 链 1:1 解释器(Modifiers.cs / Actions.cs 逐条核实) ----------
427	// 三条权威语义(旧实现全部踩错,修复根因):
428	//  · Dither(p)(Modifiers.cs:621-635):p 是【失败率】——NextDouble() >= p 才放行,
429	//    即 Dither(0.85) 通过率仅 15%。旧实现把 0.85 当通过率(< 0.85 即过),七主题
430	//    蚀变量级整体取反(C1)。
431	//  · Blotches(Modifiers.cs:92-152,Apply :131-152):每点【先丢 1 掷】,再
432	//    NextDouble() < chance 决定是否成斑;成斑再掷 4 次(Next(1-minX,1)/Next(0,maxX)/
433	//    Next(1-minY,1)/Next(0,maxY))并把后续链应用到随机矩形(会外溢房外);未成斑
434	//    则原点继续。旧实现用自制哈希值噪声替斑,分布与掷骰数都不对(C2)。
435	//  · 链序 = 掷骰序:Dither/Blotches 永远排在 OnlyTiles/OnlyWalls 之前
436	//    (各 *HouseBuilder.cs AgeRoom),对房间矩形内每格都掷,失败短路后不耗 RNG(C3);
437	//    墙动作的 worldSurface 二选一按【房间】room.Y 判定(WoodHouseBuilder.cs:36 /
438	//    IceHouseBuilder.cs:32),非逐格。
439	type ChainStep =
440	  | { k: 'dither'; p: number }                                            // Modifiers.Dither
441	  | { k: 'blotches'; minX: number; maxX: number; minY: number; maxY: number; chance: number } // Modifiers.Blotches
442	  | { k: 'onlyTiles'; types: number[] }                                   // Modifiers.OnlyTiles(Modifiers.cs:238)
443	  | { k: 'onlyWalls'; types: number[] }                                   // Modifiers.OnlyWalls(Modifiers.cs:216)
444	  | { k: 'skipTiles'; types: number[] }                                   // Modifiers.SkipTiles(Modifiers.cs:392)
445	  | { k: 'isEmpty' }                                                      // Modifiers.IsEmpty(Modifiers.cs:539)
446	  | { k: 'offset'; dx: number; dy: number }                               // Modifiers.Offset(Modifiers.cs:603)
447	  | { k: 'setTileKeepWall'; tile: number }                                // Actions.SetTileKeepWall(Actions.cs:272)
448	  | { k: 'setTile'; tile: number }                                        // Actions.SetTile(Actions.cs:203)
449	  | { k: 'clearTile' }                                                    // Actions.ClearTile(Actions.cs:155)
450	  | { k: 'clearWall'; frame?: boolean }                                   // Actions.ClearWall(Actions.cs:171；frame=true → 四邻 SquareWallFrame 掷)
451	  | { k: 'placeWall'; wall: number }                                      // Actions.PlaceWall(Actions.cs:516)
452	  | { k: 'stalagtite' }                                                   // ActionStalagtite → WorldGen.PlaceTight
453	  | { k: 'vines'; min: number; max: number; vine: number };               // ActionVines
454	
455	// ---------- 墙重帧掷（尾批 2-C ★房屋链欠掷 5 万主根因）----------
456	// Actions.PlaceWall/ClearWall(frameNeighbors:true) → WorldGen.SquareWallFrame(x,y)
457	// 【resetFrame:true 默认】→ Framing.WallFrame 中心格掷 Next(0,3)（Framing.cs:388-397，
458	// wallFrameNumber 重置）；墙 21 命中再掷 Next(2)。SquareWallFrame 本体对 8 邻格用
459	// resetFrame:false（零掷）。豁免：wall==0（早退）/wallLargeFrames∈{1,2}（查表分支
460	// 零掷——Main.cs:9652+ 全表 {224,323-330,179,146,147,167,185,274,354,355,358,359,
461	// 362,363,366}）。PlaceWall.Apply 序（Actions.cs:528-538）：置墙 → SquareWallFrame(x,y)
462	// → (x+1,y)/(x-1,y)/(x,y-1)/(x,y+1) 四邻（各中心格按彼时墙值判定掷否）。
463	// ClearWall(true) 同四邻序、无自格（WorldUtils.cs:67-76）。
464	const WALL_LARGE_FRAMES = new Set([224, 323, 324, 325, 326, 327, 328, 329, 330, 179, 146, 147, 167, 185, 274, 354, 355, 358, 359, 362, 363, 366]);
465	/** SquareWallFrame(x,y,resetFrame=true) 的中心格掷骰语义（结果不入墙帧——仅保流） */
466	function wallFrameResetRoll(st: TileStore, rng: RNG, x: number, y: number): void {
467	  if (x <= 0 || y <= 0 || x >= st.w - 1 || y >= st.h - 1) return;  // Framing.WallFrame 边界早退
468	  const w = st.wall[st.idx(x, y)];
469	  if (w === 0) return;                    // 墙 0 → 无掷
470	  if (WALL_LARGE_FRAMES.has(w)) return;   // 大帧墙查表分支 → 无掷
471	  rng.int(0, 2);                          // num2 = Next(0,3)
472	  if (w === 21) rng.int(0, 1);            // 墙 21 花墙 → Next(2)
473	}
474	/** Actions.PlaceWall（neighbors=true 恒真）逐格掷序 */
475	function placeWallRolled(st: TileStore, rng: RNG, x: number, y: number, wall: number): void {
476	  st.setWallSilent(x, y, wall);
477	  wallFrameResetRoll(st, rng, x, y);
478	  wallFrameResetRoll(st, rng, x + 1, y);
479	  wallFrameResetRoll(st, rng, x - 1, y);
480	  wallFrameResetRoll(st, rng, x, y - 1);
481	  wallFrameResetRoll(st, rng, x, y + 1);
482	}
483	
484	/** GenAction.Apply 第 i 步 @ (x,y),失败短路返回 false(不执行后续步骤、不耗 RNG) */
485	function applyChain(st: TileStore, rng: RNG, steps: ChainStep[], i: number, x: number, y: number): boolean {
486	  if (i >= steps.length) return true;
487	  const s = steps[i];
488	  switch (s.k) {
489	    case 'dither':
490	      // Modifiers.cs:630-635:NextDouble() >= _failureChance 才 UnitApply
491	      return rng.next() >= s.p && applyChain(st, rng, steps, i + 1, x, y);
492	    case 'blotches': {
493	      rng.next();                                                    // 丢 1 掷(Modifiers.cs:132)
494	      if (rng.next() < s.chance) {                                   // 成斑判定(:133)
495	        const x0 = rng.int(1 - s.minX, 0);                           // Next(1-minX, 1)(:136)
496	        const x1 = rng.int(0, s.maxX - 1);                           // Next(0, maxX)(:137)
497	        const y0 = rng.int(1 - s.minY, 0);                           // Next(1-minY, 1)(:138)
498	        const y1 = rng.int(0, s.maxY - 1);                           // Next(0, maxY)(:139)
499	        let ok = true;                                               // flag |= !UnitApply(:140-145)
500	        for (let dx = x0; dx <= x1; dx++) {
501	          for (let dy = y0; dy <= y1; dy++) {
502	            if (!applyChain(st, rng, steps, i + 1, x + dx, y + dy)) ok = false;
503	          }
504	        }
505	        return ok;
506	      }
507	      return applyChain(st, rng, steps, i + 1, x, y);                // 未成斑原点继续(:148)
508	    }
509	    case 'onlyTiles': {
510	      if (!activeAt(st, x, y)) return false;                         // !active → Fail(:245)
511	      const t = st.type[st.idx(x, y)];
512	      return s.types.includes(t) && applyChain(st, rng, steps, i + 1, x, y);
513	    }
514	    case 'onlyWalls':
515	      // Blotches 扇出可外溢房外 1 格,读前兜底(房间本体 InWorld 10 边距本已安全)
516	      return st.inBounds(x, y) && s.types.includes(st.wall[st.idx(x, y)])
517	        && applyChain(st, rng, steps, i + 1, x, y);
518	    case 'skipTiles': {
519	      if (!activeAt(st, x, y)) return applyChain(st, rng, steps, i + 1, x, y); // !active 放行(:399)
520	      return !s.types.includes(st.type[st.idx(x, y)]) && applyChain(st, rng, steps, i + 1, x, y);
521	    }
522	    case 'isEmpty':
523	      return !activeAt(st, x, y) && applyChain(st, rng, steps, i + 1, x, y);
524	    case 'offset':
525	      return applyChain(st, rng, steps, i + 1, x + s.dx, y + s.dy);
526	    case 'setTileKeepWall':
527	      // Actions.cs:272-301:存墙→Clear(~(Wiring|Actuator))【液体/坡度/半砖/块漆全清】→
528	      //   写 type+active→还原墙(+墙帧)。setTileSilent 不清液体/坡度——两处补齐
529	      //   （坡度残留曾致 house27 (1210,957) 腿 slope=2 拒箱,vanilla 落 957 成箱）。
530	      if (st.inBounds(x, y)) {
531	        const ci = st.idx(x, y);
532	        st.liquid[ci] = 0;
533	        st.liquidType[ci] = 0;
534	        st.slope[ci] = 0;
535	        st.half[ci] = 0;
536	      }
537	      st.setTileSilent(x, y, s.tile);
538	      return applyChain(st, rng, steps, i + 1, x, y);
539	    case 'setTile':
540	      // Actions.cs:203-218:setSelfFrames 之外的默认 clearTile=true →
541	      //   tile.Clear(~(Wiring|Actuator)) —— Tile.cs Clear 掩码含 Wall/WallPaint/
542	      //   Liquid(含 liquidType)/Slope：置块同时【把墙清 0】。木屋①蛛网 SetTile(51)/
543	      //   蘑菇② SetTile(71) 因此把内腔墙抹掉 → 后续②墙链 OnlyWalls(WallType) 在
544	      //   这些格 Fail 不掷——曾漏此语义（setTileSilent 不动墙）致 ② 过掷
545	      //   （house0 ② vanilla 215 vs JS 238，AB#558 段实测）。
546	      if (st.inBounds(x, y)) {
547	        const ci = st.idx(x, y);
548	        st.wall[ci] = 0;
549	        st.liquid[ci] = 0;
550	        st.liquidType[ci] = 0;
551	        st.slope[ci] = 0;
552	        st.half[ci] = 0;
553	      }
554	      st.setTileSilent(x, y, s.tile);
555	      return applyChain(st, rng, steps, i + 1, x, y);
556	    case 'clearTile':
557	      st.setTileSilent(x, y, 0);
558	      // ★ClearTile(frameNeighbors:true)（木屋③专属路径）→ 四邻 WorldGen.TileFrame →
559	      //   TileFrameImportant → Check3x2/Check2xX/CheckChand… 重验支承：支承行任一格
560	      //   （或吊灯顶锚）已失实 → destroyObject+KillTile 整件（Check3x2 cs KillTile 段）
561	      //   ——worldgen 期 KillTile 零掷（house1 ③ 120 掷精确含四件击杀实锤）。不建模则
562	      //   家具滞留 → 箱级联占位失败流漂（house1 钢琴占 (2037..2039,353) 挡 vanilla 箱
563	      //   (2038,355) 的 AB#560 首异实锤）。
564	      killUnsupportedFurniture(st, rng, x + 1, y);
565	      killUnsupportedFurniture(st, rng, x - 1, y);
566	      killUnsupportedFurniture(st, rng, x, y + 1);
567	      killUnsupportedFurniture(st, rng, x, y - 1);
568	      return applyChain(st, rng, steps, i + 1, x, y);
569	    case 'clearWall':
570	      // WorldUtils.ClearWall(x,y,frame)：清墙后 frame=true 时四邻 SquareWallFrame
571	      // （中心格掷——尾批 2-C 墙重帧掷模型）；frame 缺省 false（蘑菇 ③）零掷
572	      st.setWallSilent(x, y, 0);
573	      if (s.frame) {
574	        wallFrameResetRoll(st, rng, x + 1, y);
575	        wallFrameResetRoll(st, rng, x - 1, y);
576	        wallFrameResetRoll(st, rng, x, y - 1);
577	        wallFrameResetRoll(st, rng, x, y + 1);
578	      }
579	      return applyChain(st, rng, steps, i + 1, x, y);
580	    case 'placeWall':
581	      placeWallRolled(st, rng, x, y, s.wall);
582	      return applyChain(st, rng, steps, i + 1, x, y);
583	    case 'stalagtite':
584	      placeTight(st, rng, x, y);                                     // ActionStalagtite 恒 UnitApply
585	      return applyChain(st, rng, steps, i + 1, x, y);
586	    case 'vines': {
587	      // ActionVines.cs:21-35:len=Next(min,max+1);逐格向下铺到实心;i>0 才算成功
588	      const len = rng.int(s.min, s.max);
589	      let placed = 0;
590	      for (let k = 0; k < len && st.inBounds(x, y + k) && !activeAt(st, x, y + k); k++) {
591	        st.setTileSilent(x, y + k, s.vine, 0, 0);
592	        placed++;
593	      }
594	      return placed > 0 && applyChain(st, rng, steps, i + 1, x, y);
595	    }
596	  }
597	}
598	
599	/** WorldUtils.Gen + Shapes.Rectangle(Shapes.cs Rectangle.Perform):x 外层 / y 内层 */
600	function genRect(st: TileStore, rng: RNG, steps: ChainStep[], ox: number, oy: number, w: number, h: number): void {
601	  const __g = (globalThis as { __swAgeGen?: (o: number, x: number, y: number, w: number, h: number, k: number) => void }).__swAgeGen;
602	  const __rn = () => (globalThis as { __swRollN?: number }).__swRollN ?? -1;
603	  __g?.(__rn(), ox, oy, w, h, steps[0]?.k === 'dither' && steps[1]?.k === 'blotches' ? 1 : 0);
604	  for (let x = ox; x < ox + w; x++) {
605	    for (let y = oy; oy + h > y; y++) applyChain(st, rng, steps, 0, x, y);
606	  }
607	  __g?.(__rn(), ox, oy, w, h, -1);
608	}

610	// ---------- 跨物件帧杀级联（WWWW 2026-08-19） ----------
611	// vanilla 本 pass 的写（壳层/门/平台/梁/宝箱）经 SetFrames(frameNeighbors)/
612	// ClearTile(frameNeighbors) → TileFrameImportant 分派 Check2xX(105/349 雕像)/
613	// Check3x2(186/187 骨堆)/CheckPile+Check2x1(185 小堆)/Check2x2(巨石族 484 滚地
614	// 仙人掌等)/CheckOrb(12 水晶心)/CheckStalactite(165)：**整盒完整性**（任一格被
615	// 覆写/失活）或支撑失守 → KillTile 整件。旧实现仅登记本屋家具（killUnsupported
616	// Furniture），pre-existing 物件（雕像 pass 的 105/地层 pass 的 187/484/12/165）
617	// 与被宝箱半覆写的 186/185 全部漏杀 = #59 残 54 格的全部剩余。
618	// ★KillTile 生成期语义（cs:63589 isGeneratingOrLoadingWorld → noItem；掷流对齐
619	//   实证 #60-62 全绿）= 纯失活零掷；杀=失活+清 half/slope（TileFrame 失活分支），
620	//   type/帧保留（stale type 下游按 vanilla 同读）。触发面=每阶段末扫房间 halo ±10
621	//   （54 格残差全落房间 ±8 实证）；级联迭代至稳定。
622	const KF_STATUE = new Set([105, 349]);          // Check2xX（2×3，104 五行/207 四行不在此域）
623	const KF_PILE3x2 = new Set([186, 187]);         // Check3x2（3×2）
624	const KF_HEART = 12;                             // CheckOrb（2×2；31/639/696 同族不在屋域）
625	const KF_SMALLPILE = 185;                        // CheckPile → Check2x1（2×1）
626	/** Check2x2 巨石族的"箱下有箱/桌豁免"（BasicChest+Fake+88 梳妆台+470/475） */
627	const KF_CHEST_LIKE = new Set([21, 467, 88, 470, 475]);
628	const KF_SNOW = new Set([147, 161, 162, 163, 164, 200, 224]);
629	const KF_SANDFAM = new Set([53, 112, 116, 117, 234, 396, 397, 398, 399, 402, 403]);  // Sand/HardenedSand/Sandstone 转化集（sheet 空间）
630	const KF_MUD = new Set([59, 60, 70, 199, 226]);   // Mud 集 + 70 丛林泥近似（v_59=泥岩? 取 Mud 转化族）
631	
632	function kfSheetAt(st: TileStore, x: number, y: number): number {
633	  const i = st.idx(x, y);
634	  return st.flags[i] ? (TILE_DEFS[st.type[i]]?.vanilla?.sheet ?? -1) : -1;
635	}
636	function kfKillCell(st: TileStore, x: number, y: number): void {
637	  if (!st.inBounds(x, y)) return;
638	  // KillTile（cs:63964-63966）：type=0 + 失活 + 尾 SquareTileFrame——stale type
639	  // 下游可读（CanGeneratePressurePlateAt 按型拒等），故清 type（setTileSilent(0)）
640	  const i = st.idx(x, y);
641	  st.setTileSilent(x, y, 0);
642	}
643	
644	// ---------- 帧杀触发拓扑（WWWW）----------
645	// vanilla 只对本 pass 里【带帧写入】的阶段触发 Check*：PlaceTile 尾 SquareTileFrame
646	// 九宫（fr/ch/bp/bt/st/pl）+ SetFrames(frameNeighbors)/ClearTile(frameNeighbors)
647	// （er/do/sb）。**蚀变 ar 的裸 SetTile/SetTileKeepWall(setSelfFrames) 不触发**
648	// ——g59 保留 (2634,479) 三格残破仙人掌（邻居是被裸 SetTile(51) 蛛网覆写）与
649	// (2665,607) 先在残破仙人掌实证：不被帧触即不杀。→ 阶段快照 diff 出变更格，
650	// 仅对其九宫内的家族物件跑 Check（级联=杀格再入队）。
651	interface KillSnap { x0: number; y0: number; x1: number; y1: number; f: Uint8Array; t: Uint16Array }
652	function killSnap(st: TileStore, rooms: Rect[]): KillSnap {
653	  let x0 = 1e9, y0 = 1e9, x1 = -1e9, y1 = -1e9;
654	  for (const r of rooms) {
655	    x0 = Math.min(x0, r.x - 12); y0 = Math.min(y0, r.y - 12);
656	    x1 = Math.max(x1, r.x + r.w + 12); y1 = Math.max(y1, r.y + r.h + 52);
657	  }
658	  x0 = Math.max(0, x0); y0 = Math.max(0, y0); x1 = Math.min(st.w - 1, x1); y1 = Math.min(st.h - 1, y1);
659	  const w = x1 - x0 + 1;
660	  const f = new Uint8Array(w * (y1 - y0 + 1));
661	  const t = new Uint16Array(w * (y1 - y0 + 1));
662	  for (let y = y0; y <= y1; y++) {
663	    for (let x = x0; x <= x1; x++) {
664	      const i = st.idx(x, y), q = (y - y0) * w + (x - x0);
665	      f[q] = st.flags[i]!; t[q] = st.type[i]!;
666	    }
667	  }
668	  return { x0, y0, x1, y1, f, t };
669	}
670	
671	/** 帧杀扫描：snap→现在 的变更格九宫内家族物件 → Check* 击杀（级联至稳定） */
672	function frameKillSweep(st: TileStore, rng: RNG, rooms: Rect[], snap: KillSnap): void {
673	  const w = snap.x1 - snap.x0 + 1;
674	  const queue: number[] = [];
675	  for (let y = snap.y0; y <= snap.y1; y++) {
676	    for (let x = snap.x0; x <= snap.x1; x++) {
677	      const q = (y - snap.y0) * w + (x - snap.x0);
678	      const i = st.idx(x, y);
679	      if (snap.f[q] !== st.flags[i]! || snap.t[q] !== st.type[i]!) queue.push(i);
680	    }
681	  }
682	  const checked = new Set<number>();
683	  let guard = 0;
684	  while (queue.length && guard++ < 20000) {
685	    const i = queue.shift()!;
686	    const x = i % st.w, y = Math.floor(i / st.w);
687	    for (let dy = -1; dy <= 1; dy++) {
688	      for (let dx = -1; dx <= 1; dx++) {
689	        const nx = x + dx, ny = y + dy;
690	        if (!st.inBounds(nx, ny)) continue;
691	        const ni = st.idx(nx, ny);
692	        if (!st.flags[ni] || checked.has(ni)) continue;
693	        const before = st.flags[ni]!;
694	        kfCheckObject(st, rng, ni, checked, queue);
695	        if (!st.flags[ni]!) {
696	          // 击杀 → 九宫再入队（KillTile 尾 SquareTileFrame 级联）
697	          for (let ddy = -1; ddy <= 1; ddy++) {
698	            for (let ddx = -1; ddx <= 1; ddx++) {
699	              const cx = nx + ddx, cy = ny + ddy;
700	              if (st.inBounds(cx, cy)) queue.push(st.idx(cx, cy));
701	            }
702	          }
703	        }
704	      }
705	    }
706	  }
707	}
708	
709	/** 单物件家族校验（ni=任一成员格；checked 记盒内全部格防重查） */
710	function kfCheckObject(st: TileStore, rng: RNG, ni: number, checked: Set<number>, queue: number[]): void {
711	  const x = ni % st.w, y = Math.floor(ni / st.w);
712	  const sh = TILE_DEFS[st.type[ni]]?.vanilla?.sheet ?? -1;
713	  const fx = st.frameX[ni]!, fy = st.frameY[ni]!;
714	  const markBox = (bx: number, by: number, bw: number, bh: number) => {
715	    for (let dx = 0; dx < bw; dx++) for (let dy = 0; dy < bh; dy++) {
716	      if (st.inBounds(bx + dx, by + dy)) checked.add(st.idx(bx + dx, by + dy));
717	    }
718	  };
719	  const killBox = (bx: number, by: number, bw: number, bh: number, typeId: number) => {
720	    for (let dx = 0; dx < bw; dx++) for (let dy = 0; dy < bh; dy++) {
721	      const ci = st.idx(bx + dx, by + dy);
722	      if (st.type[ci] === typeId) kfKillCell(st, bx + dx, by + dy);
723	    }
724	  };
725	  // ---- Check2xX（雕像 2×3）----
726	  if (KF_STATUE.has(sh)) {
727	    const col = Math.floor((fx % 36) / 18);
728	    let row = Math.floor(fy / 18);
729	    let rowBase = 0;
730	    while (row >= 3) { row -= 3; rowBase += 54; }
731	    const bx = x - col, by = y - row;
732	    markBox(bx, by, 2, 3);
733	    let dead = false;
734	    for (let dx = 0; dx < 2 && !dead; dx++) {
735	      for (let dy = 0; dy < 3; dy++) {
736	        const ci = st.idx(bx + dx, by + dy);
737	        if (!st.flags[ci] || st.type[ci] !== st.type[ni]
738	          || st.frameX[ci] !== fx - col * 18 + dx * 18
739	          || st.frameY[ci] !== dy * 18 + rowBase) { dead = true; break; }
740	      }
741	    }
742	    if (!dead && (!supportOk(st, bx, by + 3) || !supportOk(st, bx + 1, by + 3))) dead = true;
743	    if (dead) killBox(bx, by, 2, 3, st.type[ni]!);
744	    return;
745	  }
746	  // ---- Check3x2（186/187 骨堆）----
747	  if (KF_PILE3x2.has(sh)) {
748	    const rowIn = Math.floor((fy % 36) / 18);
749	    const rowBase = Math.floor(fy / 36) * 36;
750	    let colAcc = Math.floor(fx / 18);
751	    let styleBlock = 0;
752	    while (colAcc > 2) { colAcc -= 3; styleBlock++; }
753	    const bx = x - colAcc, by = y - rowIn;
754	    const colBase = styleBlock * 54;
755	    markBox(bx, by, 3, 2);
756	    let dead = false;
757	    for (let k2 = 0; k2 < 3 && !dead; k2++) {
758	      for (let l2 = 0; l2 < 2; l2++) {
759	        const ci = st.idx(bx + k2, by + l2);
760	        if (!st.flags[ci] || st.type[ci] !== st.type[ni]
761	          || st.frameX[ci] !== k2 * 18 + colBase
762	          || st.frameY[ci] !== l2 * 18 + rowBase) { dead = true; break; }
763	      }
764	    }
765	    if (!dead) {
766	      for (let k2 = 0; k2 < 3 && !dead; k2++) {
767	        const sx = bx + k2, sy = by + 2;
768	        if (!supportOk(st, sx, sy)) { dead = true; break; }
769	        const bs = kfSheetAt(st, sx, sy);
770	        if (BOULDERS.has(bs)) { dead = true; break; }
771	        if (!st.inBounds(sx, sy) || !st.flags[st.idx(sx, sy)]) continue;
772	        if (st.type[ni] === TILE_BY_KEY['v_186_decos_3x2']!) {
773	          if (styleBlock >= 26 && styleBlock <= 31 && !KF_SNOW.has(bs)) dead = true;
774	          else if (styleBlock >= 32 && styleBlock <= 34 && !KF_MUD.has(bs) && bs !== 70) dead = true;
775	        } else {
776	          if (styleBlock <= 5 && !KF_MUD.has(bs) && bs !== 60 && bs !== 226) dead = true;
777	          else if (styleBlock >= 6 && styleBlock <= 8 && ![57, 58, 75, 76].includes(bs)) dead = true;
778	          else if (styleBlock >= 29 && styleBlock <= 34 && !KF_SANDFAM.has(bs)) dead = true;
779	        }
780	      }
781	    }
782	    if (dead) killBox(bx, by, 3, 2, st.type[ni]!);
783	    return;
784	  }
785	  // ---- Check2x1（185 小堆）----
786	  if (sh === KF_SMALLPILE) {
787	    const bx = fx % 36 === 18 ? x - 1 : x;
788	    markBox(bx, y, 2, 1);
789	    let dead = false;
790	    const r0 = st.idx(bx, y), r1 = st.idx(bx + 1, y);
791	    if (!st.flags[r1] || st.type[r1] !== st.type[ni] || st.frameX[r1] !== st.frameX[r0]! + 18) dead = true;
792	    if (!dead && (!supportOk(st, bx, y + 1) || !supportOk(st, bx + 1, y + 1))) dead = true;
793	    if (!dead && (BOULDERS.has(kfSheetAt(st, bx, y + 1)) || BOULDERS.has(kfSheetAt(st, bx + 1, y + 1)))) dead = true;
794	    if (!dead) {
795	      const num = Math.floor(fx / 18);
796	      const bl = kfSheetAt(st, bx, y + 1), br = kfSheetAt(st, bx + 1, y + 1);
797	      if (num >= 36 && num <= 47 && !KF_SNOW.has(bl) && !KF_SNOW.has(br)) dead = true;
798	      else if ((num >= 54 && num <= 59) || (num >= 73 && num <= 76)) {
799	        if (!KF_SANDFAM.has(bl) && !KF_SANDFAM.has(br)) dead = true;
800	      }
801	    }
802	    if (dead) killBox(bx, y, 2, 1, st.type[ni]!);
803	    return;
804	  }
805	  // ---- CheckOrb（12 水晶心 2×2）----
806	  if (sh === KF_HEART) {
807	    const bx = fx !== 0 && fx !== 36 ? x - 1 : x;
808	    const by = fy !== 0 ? y - 1 : y;
809	    markBox(bx, by, 2, 2);
810	    let dead = false;
811	    for (let k2 = 0; k2 < 2 && !dead; k2++) {
812	      for (let l2 = 0; l2 < 2; l2++) {
813	        const ci = st.idx(bx + k2, by + l2);
814	        if (!st.flags[ci] || st.type[ci] !== st.type[ni]) { dead = true; break; }
815	      }
816	      if (!dead && !supportOk(st, bx + k2, by + 2)) dead = true;
817	    }
818	    if (dead) killBox(bx, by, 2, 2, st.type[ni]!);
819	    return;
820	  }
821	  // ---- Check2x2（巨石族 484 等）----
822	  if (BOULDERS.has(sh)) {
823	    let colOff = -Math.floor(fx / 18);
824	    let extra = 0;
825	    if (colOff < -1) { colOff += 2; extra = 36; }
826	    const bx = x + colOff;
827	    let fyAcc = fy;
828	    let rowBase = 0;
829	    while (fyAcc >= 36) { fyAcc -= 36; rowBase++; }
830	    const by = y - Math.floor(fyAcc / 18);
831	    markBox(bx, by, 2, 2);
832	    let dead = false;
833	    for (let k2 = 0; k2 < 2 && !dead; k2++) {
834	      for (let l2 = 0; l2 < 2; l2++) {
835	        const ci = st.idx(bx + k2, by + l2);
836	        if (!st.flags[ci] || st.type[ci] !== st.type[ni]
837	          || st.frameX[ci] !== k2 * 18 + extra
838	          || st.frameY[ci] !== l2 * 18 + rowBase * 36) { dead = true; break; }
839	      }
840	    }
841	    if (!dead) {
842	      const bl = kfSheetAt(st, bx, by + 2), br = kfSheetAt(st, bx + 1, by + 2);
843	      const chestLike = KF_CHEST_LIKE.has(bl) || KF_CHEST_LIKE.has(br);
844	      if (!chestLike && !supportOk(st, bx, by + 2) && !supportOk(st, bx + 1, by + 2)) dead = true;
845	    }
846	    if (dead) killBox(bx, by, 2, 2, st.type[ni]!);
847	    return;
848	  }
849	  // ---- CheckStalactite（165）----
850	  if (sh === 165) {
851	    checked.add(ni);
852	    checkStalactite(st, rng, x, y);
853	    return;
854	  }
855	  checked.add(ni);
856	}

858	// ---------- 钟乳石(WorldGen.PlaceTight 1:1) ----------
859	// ★WWWW 2026-08-19：本文件旧有「仅冰族」的 PlaceUncheckedStalactite 局部近似
860	//   （注释断言"地下屋上方恒主题块→名单外静默返回"）——对沙漠屋（上方 396/397
861	//   →378 列）/花岗岩（368→432）/大理石（367→486）全部漏放 → #59 残 135 格
862	//   T165 差（9293480 house#35 顶/底行 golden 实锤）。改用 ShimmerPass 的全量
863	//   1:1 实现（垂挂/地面双形族+CheckStalactite 尾+style 失配补掷——屋内材质族
864	//   恒 match 零补掷，掷流不变）。
865	
866	/** AgeRoom 七主题蚀变:逐主题把原版 WorldUtils.Gen 链逐条转录(行号 = 各
867	 *  *HouseBuilder.cs AgeRoom)。Dither/Blotches 语义见 applyChain 头注(C1/C2/C3) */
868	function ageRoom(st: TileStore, rng: RNG, gs: GenState, r: Rect, theme: Theme, def: ThemeDef): void {
869	  // Blotches(scale=2)→ minX=maxX=minY=maxY=2(Modifiers.cs:95-100)
870	  const B2 = (chance: number): ChainStep => ({ k: 'blotches', minX: 2, maxX: 2, minY: 2, maxY: 2, chance });
871	  // 墙段收尾:room.Y > worldSurface 时清墙、否则铺墙——按【房间】整体二选一
872	  // (WoodHouseBuilder.cs:36 / IceHouseBuilder.cs:32 的三元表达式在链构造时求值)
873	  const wallTail = (surfaceWall: number): ChainStep[] => [
874	    { k: 'skipTiles', types: SKIP_AGING_TILES },
875	    r.y > gs.worldSurface ? { k: 'clearWall', frame: true } : { k: 'placeWall', wall: surfaceWall },
876	  ];
877	
878	  if (theme === 'wood') {
879	    // ① 蛛网(WoodHouseBuilder.cs:30-35):W*H/16 次,每处 2×2 矩形跑
880	    //   Dither(0.5)+Blotches(2,2,chance 0.3)+IsEmpty+SetTile(51)
881	    const count = Math.floor(r.w * r.h / 16);
882	    for (let c = 0; c < count; c++) {
883	      const x = rng.int(1, r.w - 2) + r.x;
884	      const y = rng.int(1, r.h - 2) + r.y;
885	      genRect(st, rng, [{ k: 'dither', p: 0.5 }, B2(0.3), { k: 'isEmpty' }, { k: 'setTile', tile: COBWEB }], x, y, 2, 2);
886	    }
887	    // ② 墙侵蚀(WoodHouseBuilder.cs:36):Dither(0.85)+Blotches()+OnlyWalls(27)+
888	    //   SkipTiles(画族)+清墙/铺土墙 2
889	    genRect(st, rng, [
890	      { k: 'dither', p: 0.85 }, B2(0.3), { k: 'onlyWalls', types: [def.wall] }, ...wallTail(2),
891	    ], r.x, r.y, r.w, r.h);
892	    // ③ 第三段(WoodHouseBuilder.cs:37,曾整体缺失 C4):Dither(0.95)+
893	    //    OnlyTiles(30,321,158)+ClearTile——剥掉木/针叶/红木主题块
894	    genRect(st, rng, [
895	      { k: 'dither', p: 0.95 },
896	      { k: 'onlyTiles', types: [T.WOOD, TILE_BY_KEY['v_321_boreal_wood']!, TILE_BY_KEY['v_158_rich_mahogany']!] },

1003	// ---------- FillRooms(画/烛台交替 + 装饰循环) ----------
1004	function fillRooms(st: TileStore, rng: RNG, r: Rect, def: ThemeDef, theme: Theme): void {
1005	  // 家具七选(HouseBuilder.FillRooms choices;沙漠 Tables2 → tile 469)
1006	  const choices: Array<[string, number]> = [
1007	    [def.tables2 ? 'v_469_tables_group_2' : 'table', def.table],
1008	    ['anvil', 0],
1009	    ['workbench', def.workbench],
1010	    ['v_86_loom', 0],
1011	    ['piano', def.piano],
1012	    ['keg', 0],
1013	    ['bookcase', def.bookcase],
1014	  ];
1015	  // 画/烛台交替:switch(i + parity%2) 仅 0/1 两档有内容(i≥2 落空,原版同款)。
1016	  //   ★HouseBuilder.cs:434-458 是裸 switch case 0/1——i≥2(w≥24 房 n=3 的第三档)
1017	  //   【无 case 落空:零放置零掷】;曾用 %2 取模回卷 → i=2 误放画/吊灯+多掷
1018	  //   RandHousePicture/Next(6)(house8 首个 30 宽房 FillRooms 61 vs vanilla 58 实锤)
1019	  const n = Math.floor(r.w / 8);
1020	  const step = Math.floor(r.w / (n + 1));
1021	  const parity = rng.int(0, 1);
1022	  for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) {
1023	    const x = (i + 1) * step + r.x;
1024	    const sw = i + (parity % 2);
1025	    if (sw > 1) continue;
1026	    if (sw === 0) {
1027	      // 画:Y + min(H/2, H-5)
1028	      const y = r.y + Math.min(Math.floor(r.h / 2), r.h - 5);
1029	      const [key, style] = theme === 'desert' ? randHousePictureDesert(rng) : randHousePicture(rng);
1030	      // 画放置零掷【勘误 2026-08-17】：PlaceTile(240/241/242/245/246) 走专属 Place*Wall
1031	      // 分支（WorldGen.cs:59962-59990），Place2x3Wall(245)/Place3x3Wall(240) 等纯放置
1032	      // 全零 genRand（:44595/:44281 实读）；TileObject.Place 的 Main.rand.Next(4)
1033	      // （TileObject.cs:792）永不达——且 genRand=>Main.rand（WorldGen.cs:4391）单流下
1034	      // houseprobe4 PT(240) 事件 Δ0 掷实锤。旧「245 补 Next(4)」系误判 PlaceTile→
1035	      // PlaceObject 派发，已撤。
1036	      placeFurniture(st, key, x, y, style);
1037	    } else {
1038	      // 烛台:PlaceChand(34)吊灯——key=chandelier(sheet 34;旧误用 'candelabra'
1039	      // =sheet 100 的独立件,case 34 永不命中 → 吊灯从未放置,room1 实锤)
1040	      const y = r.y + 1;
1041	      placeFurniture(st, 'chandelier', x, y, rng.int(0, 5));
1042	    }
1043	  }
1044	  // 装饰循环:W/8+3 件
1045	  const decoCount = Math.floor(r.w / 8) + 3;
1046	  for (let k = 0; k < decoCount; k++) {
1047	    const x = rng.int(0, r.w - 4) + 1 + r.x;
1048	    const y = r.y + r.h - 2;
1049	    switch (rng.int(0, 3)) {
1050	      case 0: {
1051	        // 小堆 185(HouseBuilder.cs:479)：style=Next(31,34) 在【调用点】恒掷
1052	        // （_random.Next(31,34) 先求值再进 PlaceSmallPile，占用与否是体内判定）——
1053	        // 旧实现把掷骰关进 !activeAt 门 → 占用格漏掷（houseprobe4 实锤：house0
1054	        // roomA it3 (765,871) 掷位 3079 处 vanilla 已掷 style、JS 直落下一迭代）。
1055	        // PlaceSmallPile size1(cs:46831)：2 宽 (x..x+1,y)，门=!anyLava+下方双格
1056	        // SolidTile2+双格 !active+type185 拒 Boulders 垫；帧 frameX=style*36(+18)/frameY=18
1057	        const style = rng.int(31, 33);
1058	        const lava = st.inBounds(x, y) && st.liquid[st.idx(x, y)] > 0 && st.liquidType[st.idx(x, y)] === 2;
1059	        if (!lava && solid2(st, x, y + 1) && solid2(st, x + 1, y + 1)
1060	          && !BOULDERS.has(sheetOf(st, x, y + 1)) && !BOULDERS.has(sheetOf(st, x + 1, y + 1))
1061	          && st.inBounds(x + 1, y) && !activeAt(st, x, y) && !activeAt(st, x + 1, y)) {
1062	          st.setTileSilent(x, y, SMALL_PILE, style * 36, 18);
1063	          st.setTileSilent(x + 1, y, SMALL_PILE, style * 36 + 18, 18);
1064	          regHouseObj(st, x, y, 2, 1, 'floor');
1065	        }
1066	        break;
1067	      }
1068	      case 1: // 骨堆 186
1069	        placeFurniture(st, 'v_186_decos_3x2', x, y, rng.int(22, 25));
1070	        break;
1071	      case 2: // 雕像(statueList[Next(2, len)],陷阱雕像照接)
1072	        placeStatue(st, rng, x, y, rng.int(2, STATUE_LIST.length - 1));
1073	        break;
1074	      case 3: {
1075	        const [key, style] = choices[rng.int(0, choices.length - 1)];
1076	        placeFurniture(st, key, x, y, style);
1077	        break;
1078	      }
1079	    }
1080	  }
1081	}

1083	// ---------- 楼梯 / 门 / 平台 / 梁 ----------
1084	/** CreateStairsList + PlaceStairs:相邻房间对角平台链 + 顶步 4×1 平台 + 斜坡 */
1085	function placeStairs(st: TileStore, rng: RNG, rooms: Rect[], def: ThemeDef): void {
1086	  for (let i = 1; i < rooms.length; i++) {
1087	    const cur = rooms[i], prev = rooms[i - 1];
1088	    const leftGap = prev.x - cur.x;
1089	    const rightGap = cur.x + cur.w - (prev.x + prev.w);
1090	    let from: { x: number; y: number };
1091	    if (leftGap > rightGap) from = { x: cur.x + cur.w - 1, y: cur.y + 1 };
1092	    else from = { x: cur.x, y: cur.y + 1 };
1093	    const steps = (cur.y + cur.h - 1) - from.y;
1094	    const dir = leftGap > rightGap ? -1 : 1;
1095	    for (let s = 0; s < steps; s++) {
1096	      const sx = from.x + dir * (s + 1), sy = from.y + s;
1097	      if (!st.inBounds(sx, sy)) continue;
1098	      // 平台帧 = PlaceTile(19, PlatformStyle)(HouseBuilder.cs:518)——case 19 走
1099	      // frameY = 18*style(WorldGen.cs:60245-60249),非 frameX;曾恒写 (0,0)(C6)。
1100	      // ★DDDD 勘误:曾按 PlaceTile 首门(EmptyTile)推「active 格拒写」——x86 对拍
1101	      //   证伪:jungle house3 ① ③ 的 OnlyTiles(158) 通道数+6=vanilla 顶/底竖直
1102	      //   出口平台照写壳行(该语境 tileSolid[19] 表值对门不可见/门恒过),恢复恒写。
1103	      st.setTileSilent(sx, sy, PLATFORM, 0, def.platformStyle * 18);
1104	      st.slope[st.idx(sx, sy)] = dir === 1 ? 1 : 2;
1105	    }
1106	    // 顶步上方 4×1 平台(HouseBuilder.cs:519)：Gen(Chain(Clear(), PlaceWall(WallType),
1107	    //   PlaceTile(19)))——★PlaceWall 逐格走墙重帧掷（Actions.Clear 清 tile+wall+liquid
1108	    //   后置墙 → 自格+四邻 SquareWallFrame 判定掷，尾批 2-C 墙掷模型）
1109	    const px = from.x + (dir === 1 ? 1 : -4);
1110	    for (let dx = 0; dx < 4; dx++) {
1111	      const cx = px + dx, cy = from.y - 1;
1112	      if (!st.inBounds(cx, cy)) continue;
1113	      st.setTileSilent(cx, cy, 0);
1114	      st.liquid[st.idx(cx, cy)] = 0;
1115	      st.liquidType[st.idx(cx, cy)] = 0;
1116	      placeWallRolled(st, rng, cx, cy, def.wall);
1117	      st.setTileSilent(cx, cy, PLATFORM, 0, def.platformStyle * 18);
1118	    }
1119	  }
1120	}

1122	/** FindSideExit(Up 搜索 + AreaOr(4,3) 任一非实心) */
1123	function findSideExit(st: TileStore, wallX: number, wallY: number, wallH: number, isLeft: boolean): number | null {
1124	  // FindSideExit（HouseBuilder.cs:554）：Up 搜索 + IsSolid().Not().AreaOr(4,3)。
1125	  //   ★GenCondition.IsValid Or 分支（GenCondition.cs:52-61）+InvertResults：任一格
1126	  //   CheckValidity(=实心)成立→返回 !Invert=false；全空才 true——即 4×3 窗口必须
1127	  //   【整体无实心】才命中。曾误读成 any-非实心 → 门/平台滥发（house0 右窗外
1128	  //   (769,869) 一格泥土即否决,旧 any 语义误命中实锤）
1129	  const startX = wallX + (isLeft ? -4 : 0);
1130	  for (let k = 0; k < wallH - 3; k++) {
1131	    const y = wallY + wallH - 3 - k;
1132	    let allAir = true;
1133	    for (let dx = 0; dx < 4 && allAir; dx++) {
1134	      for (let dy = 0; dy < 3 && allAir; dy++) {
1135	        if (solidAt(st, startX + dx, y + dy)) allAir = false;
1136	      }
1137	    }
1138	    if (allAir) return y;
1139	  }
1140	  return null;
1141	}

1143	function placeDoors(st: TileStore, rng: RNG, rooms: Rect[], def: ThemeDef): void {
1144	  for (const r of rooms) {
1145	    // 墙列矩形 (X, Y+1, 1, H-2)
1146	    // ★DDDD 逐谓词重对齐（WorldGen.PlaceTile case10 cs:59867-59906 + PlaceDoor
1147	    //   cs:31938-31960，x86 事件流+门格对拍实锤）：
1148	    //   ①清洞 = WorldUtils.ClearTile×3（tile.ClearTile()=active/slope/half 清零，
1149	    //     type/wall/liquid 保留——曾 setTileSilent(0) 连 type 清掉，PlaceChest 双腿
1150	    //     巨石门读 type 不读 act 会误判）。
1151	    //   ②PlaceTile 分支 A（j-1/-2 空 + j-3 active+tileSolid）→ PlaceDoor(i,j-1)：
1152	    //     内部再查 mount(j-3) + SolidTile(i,j+1)——j+1 恰为刚清的门洞格恒非实心
1153	    //     ⇒ 分支 A 在本语境【必败：零掷零写】（曾按 A 放门+耗 3 掷=幻影门主源）。
1154	    //   ③分支 B（j+1/+2 空 + j+3 active+tileSolid）→ PlaceDoor(i,j+1)：mount =
1155	    //     (j-1).nactive && tileSolid[type]（墙上格，仅表查不含半砖/坡）+ 地板 =
1156	    //     SolidTile(j+3)（含 !tileSolidTop/!half/slope==0）——任一败 → 零掷零写。
1157	    //   ④成门：3 格 frameX 各独立 Next(3)（variant 逐行独立——曾弃掷值全写 variant0，
1158	    //     SSS 批 (3706,699) [18,0]vs[0,0] 帧差实锤）。
1159	    const tryDoor = (x: number, exitY: number) => {
1160	      for (let dy = 0; dy < 3; dy++) {
1161	        if (!st.inBounds(x, exitY + dy)) continue;
1162	        const i = st.idx(x, exitY + dy);
1163	        st.flags[i] = 0;                 // Tile.ClearTile()：留 type/wall/liquid
1164	        st.slope[i] = 0;
1165	        st.half[i] = 0;
1166	      }
1167	      const actAt = (yy: number) => st.inBounds(x, yy) && st.flags[st.idx(x, yy)] !== 0;
1168	      const tableSolidAt = (yy: number) => {   // Main.tileSolid[type]（生成期翻转表）
1169	        if (!st.inBounds(x, yy)) return false;
1170	        return vanGenSolidType(st.type[st.idx(x, yy)]);
1171	      };
1172	      const solidTileAt = (yy: number) => {    // WorldGen.SolidTile（cs:70155 全谓词）
1173	        if (!st.inBounds(x, yy)) return false;
1174	        const i = st.idx(x, yy);
1175	        if (!st.flags[i]) return false;
1176	        const t = st.type[i];
1177	        return vanGenSolidType(t) && !HOUSE_SOLID_TOP.has(TILE_DEFS[t]?.vanilla?.sheet ?? -1)
1178	          && st.half[i] === 0 && st.slope[i] === 0;
1179	      };
1180	      if (!actAt(exitY - 1) && !actAt(exitY - 2) && actAt(exitY - 3) && tableSolidAt(exitY - 3)) {
1181	        return;                             // 分支 A：PlaceDoor 必败（地板=刚清格），零掷
1182	      }
1183	      if (actAt(exitY + 1) || actAt(exitY + 2) || !actAt(exitY + 3) || !tableSolidAt(exitY + 3)) return;
1184	      if (!(actAt(exitY - 1) && tableSolidAt(exitY - 1))) return;   // PlaceDoor mount
1185	      if (!solidTileAt(exitY + 3)) return;                          // PlaceDoor floor
1186	      const v0 = rng.int(0, 2), v1 = rng.int(0, 2), v2 = rng.int(0, 2);
1187	      placeDoorClosedRows(st, x, exitY, def.door, [v0, v1, v2]);
1188	    };
1189	    // 右侧扫描起点 = room.X+W（墙体列外一格,HouseBuilder.cs:562 wall=(X+W,Y+1,1,H-2)）
1190	    // ——曾误用墙体列 X+W-1 → 扫描窗含恒实心墙列,门外洞穴 4×3 极易命中 → 门滥发
1191	    // （house1 vanilla 无门 vs JS 误门 (2045,352) 实锤）
1192	    const exitR = findSideExit(st, r.x + r.w, r.y + 1, r.h - 2, false);

1199	/** FindVerticalExit(Left 搜索 + AreaOr(3,5) 任一非实心) */
1200	function findVerticalExit(st: TileStore, rectX: number, rectY: number, rectW: number, isUp: boolean): number | null {
1201	  const startX = rectX + rectW - 3;
1202	  const startY = rectY + (isUp ? -5 : 0);
1203	  for (let k = 0; k < rectW - 3; k++) {
1204	    const x = startX - k;
1205	    // 同 findSideExit：AreaOr(3,5)+Not = 3×5 窗口整体无实心才命中（曾误 any 语义）
1206	    let allAir = true;
1207	    for (let dx = 0; dx < 3 && allAir; dx++) {
1208	      for (let dy = 0; dy < 5 && allAir; dy++) {
1209	        if (solidAt(st, x + dx, startY + dy)) allAir = false;
1210	      }
1211	    }
1212	    if (allAir) return x;
1213	  }
1214	  return null;
1215	}

1217	function placePlatforms(st: TileStore, rooms: Rect[], def: ThemeDef): void {
1218	  const top = rooms[0], bot = rooms[rooms.length - 1];
1219	  // 顶层顶壁(isUp:候选自壁上 5 格起);帧同楼梯(C6):HouseBuilder.cs:574
1220	  //   PlaceTile(19, PlatformStyle) → frameY = 18*style。
1221	  // ★DDDD 勘误:曾按 PlaceTile 首门推「壳行 active → no-op」——x86 jungle house3
1222	  //   ① 掷数对拍证伪(vanilla 照写,JS 撤写后 ① 少 +6 掷流漂),恢复恒写。
1223	  const tryPlatform = (x: number, y: number) => {
1224	    if (st.inBounds(x, y)) {
1225	      st.setTileSilent(x, y, PLATFORM, 0, def.platformStyle * 18);
1226	    }
1227	  };
1228	  const exitT = findVerticalExit(st, top.x + 2, top.y, top.w - 4, true);
1229	  if (exitT !== null) {
1230	    for (let dx = 0; dx < 3; dx++) tryPlatform(exitT + dx, top.y);
1231	  }
1232	  if (rooms.length > 1) {
1233	    const exitB = findVerticalExit(st, bot.x + 2, bot.y + bot.h - 1, bot.w - 4, false);
1234	    if (exitB !== null) {
1235	      for (let dx = 0; dx < 3; dx++) tryPlatform(exitB + dx, bot.y + bot.h - 1);
1236	    }
1237	  }
1238	}

1240	/** CreateSupportBeamList + PlaceSupportBeams:6→4 步长梁列,落下一房顶/实心 */
1241	function placeSupportBeams(st: TileStore, rooms: Rect[], def: ThemeDef): void {
1242	  const minX = Math.min(...rooms.map((r) => r.x));
1243	  const maxX = Math.max(...rooms.map((r) => r.x + r.w)) - 1;
1244	  let step = 6;
1245	  while (step > 4 && (maxX - minX) % step !== 0) step--;
1246	  for (let x = minX; x <= maxX; x += step) {
1247	    for (let ri = 0; ri < rooms.length; ri++) {
1248	      const r = rooms[ri];
1249	      if (x < r.x || x >= r.x + r.w) continue;
1250	      const bottom = r.y + r.h;
1251	      let limit = 50;
1252	      for (let rj = ri + 1; rj < rooms.length; rj++) {
1253	        const r2 = rooms[rj];
1254	        if (x >= r2.x && x < r2.x + r2.w) limit = Math.min(limit, r2.y - bottom);
1255	      }
1256	      if (limit <= 0) continue;
1257	      let found = -1;
1258	      if (limit < 50) found = bottom + limit; // 原版:num7<50 视为命中下一房顶
1259	      else {
1260	        for (let y = bottom; y < bottom + limit; y++) {
1261	          if (solidAt(st, x, y)) { found = y; break; }
1262	        }
1263	      }
1264	      if (found < 0) continue;
1265	      const height = found - bottom;
1266	      if (height > 1 && st.type[st.idx(x, bottom - 1)] !== PLATFORM) {
1267	        // SetTileKeepWall(BeamType)：Clear(~(Wiring|Actuator)) → 液体/坡度/半砖全清
1268	        // （WWWW：曾漏清液体 → 梁格带水 78 格 L/Y 差（house12 (3207..3221,361-366)
1269	        // golden 梁无水 JS 有水））；梁底下一格 slope(0)/half(false)（HouseBuilder.cs:604）
1270	        for (let y = bottom; y < found; y++) {
1271	          const ci = st.idx(x, y);
1272	          st.liquid[ci] = 0;
1273	          st.liquidType[ci] = 0;
1274	          st.slope[ci] = 0;
1275	          st.half[ci] = 0;
1276	          st.setTileSilent(x, y, def.beam, 0, 0);
1277	        }
1278	        if (st.inBounds(x, found)) {
1279	          const bi = st.idx(x, found);
1280	          st.slope[bi] = 0;
1281	          st.half[bi] = 0;
1282	        }
1283	      }
1284	    }
1285	  }
1286	}

1289	/** HouseBuilder.cs:764-826/838-865/881-907 共形级联:逐房【底行 Y+H-2】先 10 次
1290	 *  随机(Next(2,W-2)+X)再整行扫描;仅 Bast 有顶行 Y-1 兜底级联(:798-825)。
1291	 *  任一命中即停(true = 放置成功,调用方据此递增计数)。
1292	 *  旧实现是"rooms[0] 单发随机公式"——三级级联与逐房推进全部缺失(C7) */
1293	function cascadePlace(st: TileStore, rng: RNG, rooms: Rect[], key: string, ceilingFallback: boolean): boolean {
1294	  const tryRow = (r: Rect, y: number): boolean => {
1295	    for (let t = 0; t < 10; t++) {
1296	      if (placeFurniture(st, key, rng.int(2, r.w - 3) + r.x, y)) return true;
1297	    }
1298	    // 扫描段「成功」= PlaceTile 返回值 = 锚格 active(★任意件——含既有家具!
1299	    //   PlaceTile 尾段 `if (tile.active()) result=true`(cs:60279-60286)读的是
1300	    //   锚格终态,Place3x2 被占失败时锚格若原就 active → 返回 true。vanilla
1301	    //   house10 磨刀站 sweep 踩工作台 87 上 → flag=true 计数+1 而实际未放置
1302	    //   ——SharpenerCount 与 JS 分歧 → house33 丛林门翻转(3<4 vs 4≥4)实锤)
1303	    for (let x = r.x + 2; x <= r.x + r.w - 2; x++) {
1304	      placeFurniture(st, key, x, y);
1305	      if (activeAt(st, x, y)) return true;
1306	    }
1307	    return false;
1308	  };
1309	  for (const r of rooms) if (tryRow(r, r.y + r.h - 2)) return true;
1310	  if (ceilingFallback) {
1311	    for (const r of rooms) if (tryRow(r, r.y - 1)) return true;
1312	  }
1313	  return false;
1314	}

1316	// ---------- 宝箱四级联(PlaceChests) ----------
1317	function placeChests(st: TileStore, rng: RNG, gs: GenState, chests: ChestSink, rooms: Rect[], def: ThemeDef, theme: Theme): void {
1318	  // 头掷（HouseBuilder.cs:672）：`NextDouble() > ChestChance` —— ChestChance=1.0
1319	  // 恒过门但【掷骰照耗】。旧实现缺此掷 → 箱段流漂 -1（house0 AB#558 dk=-1 实锤）
1320	  rng.next();
1321	  const tryAt = (x: number, y: number): boolean => {
1322	    const underground = y > gs.worldSurface;
1323	    // 冰屋：显式 style 11 直入冰箱门（cs:36107 第一析取）→ 主件池 + 1/20 提炼机 +
1324	    // 1/50 鱼覆盖块自动生效（旧实现显式 loot 绕过覆盖——审计三.4 修复）
1325	    return placeBuriedChest(st, rng, gs, chests, x, y, {
1326	      style: underground ? def.chestStyle : 0,
1327	      tile: underground && def.chestTile2 ? CHEST2 : undefined,
1328	      flags: theme === 'ice' ? { ice: true } : (!underground ? { wooden: true } : {}),
1329	    });
1330	  };
1331	  // 级联 1:各房底行随机 10 次
1332	  for (const r of rooms) {
1333	    const floorY = r.y + r.h - 1;
1334	    let ok = false;
1335	    for (let t = 0; t < 10 && !ok; t++) ok = tryAt(rng.int(2, r.w - 3) + r.x, floorY);
1336	    if (ok) return;
1337	    for (let x = r.x + 2; x <= r.x + r.w - 2 && !ok; x++) ok = tryAt(x, floorY);
1338	    if (ok) return;
1339	  }
1340	  // 级联 2:各房顶行(Y-1)
1341	  for (const r of rooms) {
1342	    const ceilY = r.y - 1;
1343	    let ok = false;
1344	    for (let t = 0; t < 10 && !ok; t++) ok = tryAt(rng.int(2, r.w - 3) + r.x, ceilY);
1345	    if (ok) return;
1346	    for (let x = r.x + 2; x <= r.x + r.w - 2 && !ok; x++) ok = tryAt(x, ceilY);
1347	    if (ok) return;
1348	  }
1349	  // 级联 3:房外 ±30 随机 1000 次
1350	  for (let t = 0; t < 1000; t++) {
1351	    if (tryAt(rng.int(rooms[0].x - 30, rooms[0].x + 29), rng.int(rooms[0].y - 30, rooms[0].y + 29))) return;
1352	  }
1353	}

1358	/** pass 59 头四计数连掷(cs:17081-17084,序=CaveHouse→Underworld→CaveChest→
1359	 *  AdditionalDesert)——本仓 pass 拆分后各消费 pass 流位分散,由本函数在管线中
1360	 *  第一个消费 pass 之前统一预掷暂存 gs(WorldGen.ts 接线)。四枚均为

1362	 *  CaveHouse/CaveChest=35-40×WorldArea、Underworld=10-15×WorldWidth/4200、
1363	 *  AdditionalDesert=2-2×WorldArea(恒掷一骰)。幂等:已预掷(≥0)直接返回。 */
1364	export function rollHouseChestCounts(st: TileStore, rng: RNG, gs: GenState): void {
1365	  if (gs.caveHouseCount >= 0) return;
1366	  const area = (st.w * st.h) / 5040000;
1367	  const wsc = st.w / 4200;
1368	  gs.caveHouseCount = rng.int(Math.trunc(35 * area), Math.trunc(40 * area));
1369	  gs.underworldChestCount = rng.int(Math.trunc(10 * wsc), Math.trunc(15 * wsc));
1370	  gs.caveChestCount = rng.int(Math.trunc(35 * area), Math.trunc(40 * area));
1371	  gs.desertHouseCount = rng.int(Math.trunc(2 * area), Math.trunc(2 * area));
1372	}

77	
78	const gPath = (idx: number, ext: string) => `${G2}/${String(idx).padStart(3, '0')}_${DUMPNAME.get(idx)}.${ext}`;
79	interface Ch { t: Uint16Array; a: Uint8Array; w: Uint16Array; l: Uint8Array; hf: Uint8Array; sl: Uint8Array; lt: Uint8Array; ia: Uint8Array }
80	const chCache = new Map<number, Ch>();
81	function chans(idx: number): Ch {
82	  const hit = chCache.get(idx);
83	  if (hit) return hit;
84	  const b8 = (e: string) => new Uint8Array(readFileSync(gPath(idx, e)).buffer.slice(0));
85	  const b16 = (e: string) => new Uint16Array(readFileSync(gPath(idx, e)).buffer.slice(0));
86	  const c: Ch = { t: b16('typ'), a: b8('act'), w: b16('wal'), l: b8('liq'), hf: b8('half'), sl: b8('slope'), lt: b8('lty'), ia: b8('inact') };
87	  chCache.set(idx, c);
88	  if (chCache.size > 8) chCache.delete(chCache.keys().next().value!);
89	  return c;
90	}

92	interface Boundary { gs: GenState; gensolid: Map<number, boolean>; fx: Uint16Array; fy: Uint16Array; wire: Uint8Array; ids35: Map<number, number>; chests: unknown[] }
93	const bCache = new Map<string, Boundary>();
94	function boundary(key: string): Boundary {
95	  const hit = bCache.get(key);
96	  if (hit) return hit;
97	  const dir = `${BDIR}/${key}`;
98	  if (!existsSync(`${dir}/gs.json`)) throw new Error(`no boundary ${key}`);
99	  const gs = JSON.parse(readFileSync(`${dir}/gs.json`, 'utf8')) as GenState;
100	  const gensolid = new Map(JSON.parse(readFileSync(`${dir}/gensolid.json`, 'utf8')) as Array<[number, boolean]>);
101	  const fw = new Uint32Array(readFileSync(`${dir}/frames.bin`).buffer.slice(0));
102	  const fx = new Uint16Array(N), fy = new Uint16Array(N), wire = new Uint8Array(N);
103	  for (let q = 0; q < fw.length; q += 4) { const i = fw[q]!; fx[i] = fw[q + 1]!; fy[i] = fw[q + 2]!; wire[i] = fw[q + 3]! & 0x1f; }
104	  const iw = new Uint32Array(readFileSync(`${dir}/ids35.bin`).buffer.slice(0));
105	  const ids35 = new Map<number, number>();
106	  for (let q = 0; q < iw.length; q += 2) ids35.set(iw[q]!, iw[q + 1]!);
107	  const chests = JSON.parse(readFileSync(`${dir}/chests.json`, 'utf8')) as unknown[];
108	  const b: Boundary = { gs, gensolid, fx, fy, wire, ids35, chests };
109	  bCache.set(key, b);
110	  return b;
111	}

113	interface PrevOut { type: Uint16Array; flags: Uint8Array; fx: Uint16Array; fy: Uint16Array; wire: Uint8Array }
114	function buildHybrid(baseIdx: number, b: Boundary | PrevOut): { st: TileStore; revMiss: number } {
115	  const c = chans(baseIdx);
116	  const st = new TileStore(W, H);
117	  const fromB = 'ids35' in b;
118	  const ids35 = fromB ? (b as Boundary).ids35 : null;
119	  let revMiss = 0;
120	  for (let i = 0; i < N; i++) {
121	    const act = c.a[i]!;
122	    st.flags[i] = act;
123	    if (act || c.t[i]) {
124	      const sh = c.t[i]!;
125	      let id = ids35 && ids35.has(i) ? ids35.get(i)! : -1;
126	      if (id < 0 || SHEET[id] !== sh) { id = REV.get(sh) ?? -1; }
127	      if (id < 0) { id = 0; revMiss++; }
128	      st.type[i] = id;
129	    } else st.type[i] = 0;
130	    st.wall[i] = c.w[i]!;
131	    st.liquid[i] = c.l[i]!;
132	    st.liquidType[i] = c.l[i] ? c.lt[i]! + 1 : 0;
133	    st.half[i] = c.hf[i]!;
134	    st.slope[i] = c.sl[i]!;
135	    st.wire[i] = c.ia[i]! ? 0x20 : 0;
136	    if (fromB) {
137	      const bb = b as Boundary;
138	      st.frameX[i] = bb.fx[i]; st.frameY[i] = bb.fy[i];
139	      st.wire[i] |= bb.wire[i];
140	    } else {
141	      const p = b as PrevOut;
142	      st.frameX[i] = p.fx[i]; st.frameY[i] = p.fy[i];
143	      st.wire[i] |= p.wire[i] & 0x1f;
144	    }
145	  }
146	  return { st, revMiss };
147	}
148	const prevOf = (st: TileStore): PrevOut => ({ type: st.type.slice(), flags: st.flags.slice(), fx: st.frameX.slice(), fy: st.frameY.slice(), wire: st.wire.slice() });
149	
150	// ---- 八通道 diff（_mile8 cmp 口径）----
151	interface Row { idx: number; tag: string; dA: number; dT: number; dW: number; dL: number; dHf: number; dSl: number; dLt: number; dIa: number; first: string; pairs: Array<[string, number]>; samples: string[] }
152	function diffStore(tag: string, idx: number, st: TileStore): Row {
153	  const c = chans(idx);
154	  const r: Row = { idx, tag, dA: 0, dT: 0, dW: 0, dL: 0, dHf: 0, dSl: 0, dLt: 0, dIa: 0, first: '', pairs: [], samples: [] };
155	  const pair = new Map<string, number>();
156	  let firstI = -1;
157	  const mark = (i: number) => { if (firstI < 0) firstI = i; };
158	  for (let i = 0; i < N; i++) {
159	    const va = c.a[i]!, ja = st.flags[i]! & 1;
160	    if (va !== ja) { r.dA++; mark(i); if (r.samples.length < 10) r.samples.push(`A(${i % W},${(i / W) | 0}) v${va} j${ja}`); }
161	    const vt = va ? c.t[i]! : 0;
162	    const jt = ja ? (SHEET[st.type[i]!] >= 0 ? SHEET[st.type[i]!]! : 9999) : 0;
163	    if (vt !== jt) { r.dT++; mark(i); const k = `T${vt}>${jt}`; pair.set(k, (pair.get(k) ?? 0) + 1); if (r.samples.length < 10) r.samples.push(`T(${i % W},${(i / W) | 0}) v${vt} j${jt}`); }
164	    if (c.w[i]! !== st.wall[i]!) { r.dW++; mark(i); if (r.samples.length < 10) r.samples.push(`W(${i % W},${(i / W) | 0}) v${c.w[i]} j${st.wall[i]}`); }
165	    if (c.l[i]! !== st.liquid[i]!) { r.dL++; mark(i); if (r.samples.length < 10) r.samples.push(`L(${i % W},${(i / W) | 0}) v${c.l[i]} j${st.liquid[i]}`); }
166	    if (c.hf[i]! !== st.half[i]!) { r.dHf++; mark(i); const k = `H${c.hf[i]}>${st.half[i]}`; pair.set(k, (pair.get(k) ?? 0) + 1); if (r.samples.length < 10) r.samples.push(`H(${i % W},${(i / W) | 0}) v${c.hf[i]} j${st.half[i]}`); }
167	    if (c.sl[i]! !== st.slope[i]!) { r.dSl++; mark(i); const k = `S${c.sl[i]}>${st.slope[i]}`; pair.set(k, (pair.get(k) ?? 0) + 1); if (r.samples.length < 10) r.samples.push(`S(${i % W},${(i / W) | 0}) v${c.sl[i]} j${st.slope[i]}`); }
168	    const vl = c.l[i]! > 0 ? c.lt[i]! + 1 : 0;
169	    const jl = st.liquid[i]! > 0 ? st.liquidType[i]! : 0;
170	    if (vl !== jl) { r.dLt++; mark(i); const k = `Y${vl}>${jl}`; pair.set(k, (pair.get(k) ?? 0) + 1); if (r.samples.length < 10) r.samples.push(`Y(${i % W},${(i / W) | 0}) v${vl} j${jl} liq${c.l[i]}`); }
171	    const via = c.ia[i]! ? 1 : 0;
172	    const jia = (st.wire[i]! >>> 5) & 1;
173	    if (via !== jia) { r.dIa++; mark(i); if (r.samples.length < 10) r.samples.push(`I(${i % W},${(i / W) | 0}) v${via} j${jia}`); }
174	  }
175	  if (firstI >= 0) r.first = `(${firstI % W},${Math.floor(firstI / W)})`;
176	  r.pairs = [...pair.entries()].sort((a, b) => b[1] - a[1]).slice(0, Number(process.env.SW_WWW_PAIRS ?? 8)).map(([k, n]) => [k, n] as [string, number]);
177	  return r;
178	}
179	const isClean = (r: Row) => !(r.dA || r.dT || r.dW || r.dL || r.dHf || r.dSl || r.dLt || r.dIa);
180	function printRow(r: Row): void {
181	  const bad = !isClean(r);
182	  console.log(`${String(r.idx).padStart(3)} ${DUMPNAME.get(r.idx)} ← ${r.tag.padEnd(28)} ` +
183	    `A=${String(r.dA).padStart(6)} T=${String(r.dT).padStart(6)} W=${String(r.dW).padStart(5)} L=${String(r.dL).padStart(5)} ` +
184	    `Hf=${String(r.dHf).padStart(5)} Sl=${String(r.dSl).padStart(5)} Lt=${String(r.dLt).padStart(4)} Ia=${String(r.dIa).padStart(4)} ${bad ? '✗ ' + r.first : '✓'}`);
185	  if (bad) {
186	    console.log(`     pairs: ${r.pairs.map(([k, n]) => `${k}×${n}`).join(' ')}`);
187	    console.log(`     samples: ${r.samples.join(' | ')}`);
188	  }
189	}

201	function computeProducers(): { shrineSpots: Array<{ x: number; y: number }>; oceanTreasures: Array<{ x: number; y: number }> } {
202	  const mj = boundary('m_JungleShrines');

213	async function runSettleStep(st: TileStore, gs: GenState, rng: RNG, world: World): Promise<void> {
214	  world.store = st;
215	  world.shimmerX = gs.shimmerX; world.shimmerY = gs.shimmerY;
216	  world.genWaterLine = gs.waterLine;
217	  if ((gs.dungeonSide as number) === 0) world.genDungeonExempt = null;
218	  else {
219	    const edge = Math.floor(world.w * 0.05), mid = Math.floor(world.w * 0.55);
220	    world.genDungeonExempt = gs.dungeonSide < 0
221	      ? { x0: edge, x1: Math.floor(world.w * 0.45), y0: Math.floor(gs.worldSurface) + 10, y1: (world.h - 200) - 10 }
222	      : { x0: mid, x1: world.w - edge, y0: Math.floor(gs.worldSurface) + 10, y1: (world.h - 200) - 10 };
223	  }
224	  await settleWorldLiquids(world, 'gen', undefined, rng);
225	  flipGenSolid([484], false);
226	}

import { runSandPatchesPass, runTunnelsPass, runDirtWallBgPass, runSmallHolesPass } from '../src/world/gen/vanilla/MissingCavesPass';
import { runMountCavesPass } from '../src/world/gen/vanilla/MountCavesPass';
import { runRocksAndClayPass, runCavesPass } from '../src/world/gen/vanilla/CavesPass';
import { runIceBiomePass } from '../src/world/gen/vanilla/IceBiomePass';
import { runGrassPass } from '../src/world/gen/vanilla/GrassPass';
import { runJunglePass } from '../src/world/gen/vanilla/JunglePass';
import { runMudCavesPass } from '../src/world/gen/vanilla/Spread';
import { runDesertMoundOnly, runDesertEntrancesAndHive } from '../src/world/gen/vanilla/DesertPass';
import { runMushroomPass } from '../src/world/gen/vanilla/MushroomPass';
import { runMarblePass, runGranitePass } from '../src/world/gen/vanilla/MarbleGranitePass';
import { TILE_BY_KEY } from '../src/data/tiles';
import { RNG } from '../src/core/rng';

const SEEDTXT = process.env.SW_SEED ?? '9293480';

(RUN ? it : it.skip)('real-chain marble/granite draw counts', () => {
  const { world, rng, gs, seed } = runResetAndTerrain({ width: 4200, height: 1200, seedText: SEEDTXT, evil: 0 });
  const st = world.store;
  // 计数包装（保持 reseed 语义）
  let draws = 0;
  const oNext = rng.next.bind(rng), oInt = rng.int.bind(rng),
    oNIR = rng.nextIntRange.bind(rng), oNI = rng.nextInt.bind(rng), oR = rng.reseed.bind(rng);
  rng.next = () => { draws++; return oNext(); };
  rng.int = (a: number, b: number) => { draws++; return oInt(a, b); };
  rng.nextIntRange = (a: number, b: number) => { draws++; return oNIR(a, b); };
  rng.nextInt = (m: number) => { draws++; return oNI(m); };
  rng.reseed = (s: number) => { oR(s); };
  const replay = () => rng.reseed(seed);
  const mark = (tag: string) => { console.log(`DRAWS ${tag}=${draws}`); draws = 0; };
  replay(); runDunesPass(st, rng, gs);
  replay(); runOceanSandPass(st, rng, gs);
  replay(); runSandPatchesPass(st, rng, gs);
  replay(); runTunnelsPass(st, rng, gs);
  replay(); runMountCavesPass(st, rng, gs);
  replay(); runDirtWallBgPass(st, rng, gs);
  replay(); runRocksAndClayPass(st, rng, gs);
  replay(); runSmallHolesPass(st, rng, gs);
  replay(); runCavesPass(st, rng, gs);
  replay(); runIceBiomePass(st, rng, gs);
  replay(); runGrassPass(st, rng, gs);
  replay(); runJunglePass(st, rng, gs);
  replay(); runMudCavesPass(st, TILE_BY_KEY['mud']!, TILE_BY_KEY['v_60_jungle_grass_block']!);
  const desc = runDesertMoundOnly(st, rng, gs);
  runDesertEntrancesAndHive(st, rng, gs, desc);
  mark('desert(cum)');
  replay(); runMushroomPass(st, rng, gs); mark('mushroom');
  replay(); runMarblePass(st, rng, gs); mark('marble');
  replay(); runGranitePass(st, rng, gs); mark('granite');
  void RNG;
}, 480000);

288	      let guard = 100;

290	        x = rng.int(20, w - 21);
291	        y = rng.int(yMin, h - 301);
292	      }
293	      if (guard <= 0) { done = true; break; }
294	      // 向下扫到首个 active 格,雕像坐其上一格(cs:17014-17018)
295	      while (y < h && !st.flags[st.idx(x, y)]) y++;
296	      if (y >= h) { done = true; break; }
297	      y--;

299	      // cs:17024-17028 flag2 双门：①锚格活性且 frameImportant 且非 tileCut → 拒
300	      //   （不放不清不扫）；②锚格 anyShimmer → 拒。均计 fail 重掷。
301	      const shimmer = st.liquid[ai] > 0 && st.liquidType[ai] === 4 /* LIQ_SHIMMER */;
302	      const flag2 = !(st.flags[ai] && FR_IMPORTANT_NOCUT.has(SHEET[st.type[ai]])) && !shimmer;

310	      //   （#58 残余 7 Hf：(3063,475) 等七格 H0>1 的真身）。
